# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, RESOURCE]

  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing resource into state (APP, ADDR, ID)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu import '{{.ADDR}}' '{{.ID}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, ADDR, ID]

  tofu:show:
    desc: "Show saved plan details for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu show tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Batch Operations (all apps)
  # ===========================================================================

  tofu:plan:all:
    desc: "Run tofu plan for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh plan

  tofu:apply:all:
    desc: "Run tofu apply for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh apply

  tofu:status:
    desc: "Show recent tofu batch operation logs"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh status

# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, RESOURCE]

  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing resource into state (APP, ADDR, ID)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu import '{{.ADDR}}' '{{.ID}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, ADDR, ID]

  tofu:show:
    desc: "Show saved plan details for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu show tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Batch Operations (all apps)
  # ===========================================================================

  tofu:plan:all:
    desc: "Run tofu plan for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh plan

  tofu:apply:all:
    desc: "Run tofu apply for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh apply

  tofu:status:
    desc: "Show recent tofu batch operation logs"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh status

  # ===========================================================================
  # DNS Mode Toggle (Home/Travel)
  # ===========================================================================

  dns:home:
    desc: "Switch DNS to HOME mode (LAN IPs - no Tailscale required at home)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/network-services"
    cmds:
      - echo "🏠 Switching DNS to HOME mode (192.168.1.x)..."
      - tofu apply -var="dns_mode=home" -target=local_file.adguard_config -target=filesync_file.adguard_config -target=null_resource.restart_adguard -auto-approve
      - echo "✅ DNS mode switched to HOME"
      - echo "   AdGuard now returns LAN IPs for *.homelab.rambtech.dev"

  dns:travel:
    desc: "Switch DNS to TRAVEL mode (container IPs - routes via Tailscale)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/network-services"
    cmds:
      - echo "✈️  Switching DNS to TRAVEL mode (10.100.x.x)..."
      - tofu apply -var="dns_mode=travel" -target=local_file.adguard_config -target=filesync_file.adguard_config -target=null_resource.restart_adguard -auto-approve

# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, RESOURCE]

  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing resource into state (APP, ADDR, ID)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu import '{{.ADDR}}' '{{.ID}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, ADDR, ID]

  tofu:show:
    desc: "Show saved plan details for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu show tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Batch Operations (all apps)
  # ===========================================================================

  tofu:plan:all:
    desc: "Run tofu plan for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh plan

  tofu:apply:all:
    desc: "Run tofu apply for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh apply

  tofu:status:
    desc: "Show recent tofu batch operation logs"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh status

  # ===========================================================================
  # DNS Mode Toggle (Home/Travel)
  # ===========================================================================

  dns:home:
    desc: "Switch DNS to HOME mode (LAN IPs - no Tailscale required at home)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/network-services"
    cmds:
      - echo "🏠 Switching DNS to HOME mode (192.168.1.x)..."
      - tofu apply -var="dns_mode=home" -target=local_file.adguard_config -target=filesync_file.adguard_config -target=null_resource.restart_adguard -auto-approve
      - echo "✅ DNS mode switched to HOME"
      - echo "   AdGuard now returns LAN IPs for *.homelab.rambtech.dev"

  dns:travel:
    desc: "Switch DNS to TRAVEL mode (container IPs - routes via Tailscale). Use REMOTE=true if not on home network."
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/network-services"
    vars:
      # Use Tailscale IPs when REMOTE=true (for when you're not on home network)
      PROXMOX_ENDPOINT: '{{if eq .REMOTE "true"}}https://100.91.236.55:8006{{else}}https://192.168.1.215:8006{{end}}'
      PROXMOX_SSH: '{{if eq .REMOTE "true"}}100.91.236.55{{else}}192.168.1.215{{end}}'
    cmds:
      - echo "✈️  Switching DNS to TRAVEL mode (10.100.x.x)..."
      - 'tofu apply -var="dns_mode=travel" -var="proxmox_endpoint={{.PROXMOX_ENDPOINT}}" -var="proxmox_ssh_host={{.PROXMOX_SSH}}" -target=local_file.adguard_config -target=filesync_file.adguard_config -target=null_resource.restart_adguard -auto-approve'
      - echo "✅ DNS mode switched to TRAVEL"
      - echo "   AdGuard now returns container IPs for *.homelab.rambtech.dev"
      - echo "   Ensure Tailscale is running with 'Use Tailscale subnets' enabled"

  dns:status:
    desc: "Show current DNS mode"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/network-services"
    cmds:
      - |
        MODE=$(tofu output -raw dns_mode 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
        IP=$(tofu output -raw dns_traefik_ip 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
        echo "📡 DNS Mode: $MODE"
        echo "   Traefik IP: $IP"
        if [ "$MODE" = "home" ]; then
          echo "   Status: Using LAN IPs (no Tailscale required at home)"
        elif [ "$MODE" = "travel" ]; then
          echo "   Status: Using container IPs (routes via Tailscale)"
        fi

- echo "✅ DNS mode switched to HOME"

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The conversation is summarized below:
Analysis:
Let me chronologically analyze this conversation:

1. **Initial Problem**: User is traveling and can't access `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` URLs even with Tailscale enabled.

2. **Investigation Phase**:
   - Explored Tailscale, AdGuard, and Traefik configurations
   - Found that Split DNS is configured and working (DNS queries go through Tailscale to AdGuard)
   - DNS resolution works: `homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev` → `192.168.1.235`
   - But traffic to `192.168.1.235` goes to local network (friend's), not through Tailscale

3. **Root Cause Identified**:
   - User's friend's network uses same subnet `192.168.1.0/24` as homelab
   - macOS prefers local routes over Tailscale routes for same subnet
   - Even with Tailscale subnet routing enabled and approved, local routes win

4. **Solution Discovery**:
   - Tailscale's `10.100.0.0/16` subnet routing works without conflict

## 1. Primary Request and Intent

The user was traveling (at a friend's house in Dallas) and couldn't access their homelab services via `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` URLs despite having Tailscale enabled. The investigation revealed:

- **Root cause**: Friend's network uses same `192.168.1.0/24` subnet as homelab, causing macOS to route traffic locally instead of through Tailscale
- **Solution**: Change AdGuard DNS rewrites to return container IPs (`10.100.2.200`) instead of LAN IPs (`192.168.1.235`), which route through Tailscale without subnet conflicts
- **Final request**: Implement an IaC toggle (via Terraform/Ansible) to switch between "home" mode (LAN IPs, no Tailscale needed) and "travel" mode (container IPs, via Tailscale)

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **Tailscale subnet routing**: `192.168.1.0/24` conflicts with local networks; `10.100.0.0/16` doesn't
- **Tailscale Split DNS**: Routes DNS queries for `homelab.rambtech.dev` to AdGuard via `100.100.100.100`
- **macOS routing priority**: Local network routes (`en0`) take precedence over Tailscale (`utun9`) for same subnet
- **Dual-NIC architecture**: Traefik listens on both LAN (`192.168.1.235`) and container network (`10.100.2.200`)
- **AdGuard DNS rewrites**: Wildcard `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` → Traefik IP
- **OpenTofu templating**: Using `templatefile()` with `.tpl` files
- **Verizon G3100 router limitations**: No static route support

### `tofu/shared.tf`
Added dns_mode variable that's shared across all apps via symlink:
```hcl
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DNS Mode Configuration (Home/Travel)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "dns_mode" {
  description = "DNS resolution mode: 'home' uses LAN IPs (192.168.1.x), 'travel' uses container IPs (10.100.x.x) for Tailscale routing"
  type        = string
  default     = "home"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["home", "travel"], var.dns_mode)
    error_message = "dns_mode must be either 'home' or 'travel'"
  }
}
```

### `tofu/apps/network-services/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml.tpl`
New template file with variable interpolation for Traefik IP:
```yaml
  rewrites:
    # Mode: ${dns_mode}
    # - home: Uses LAN IPs (192.168.1.x) - works on home network without Tailscale
    # - travel: Uses container IPs (10.100.x.x) - routes through Tailscale, avoids subnet conflicts
    - domain: '*.homelab.rambtech.dev'
      answer: ${traefik_ip}
      enabled: true
    # ... more rewrites with ${traefik_ip}
```

### `tofu/apps/network-services/main.tf`
Added AdGuard config templating and sync resources:
```hcl
# Exclude AdGuard config - managed separately via templating for dns_mode toggle
exclude_patterns = ["AdGuardHome\\.yaml$", "\\.tpl$"]

# ...

locals {
  # Select IP based on dns_mode
  adguard_traefik_ip = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik : local.lan_ips.traefik
}

resource "local_file" "adguard_config" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml.tpl", {
    dns_mode   = var.dns_mode
    traefik_ip = local.adguard_traefik_ip
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/AdGuardHome.yaml"
  file_permission = "0644"
}

resource "filesync_file" "adguard_config" {
  source      = local_file.adguard_config.filename
  destination = "/config/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml"
  host        = module.network_services.ip_address
  mode = "0644"
  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

resource "null_resource" "restart_adguard" {
  triggers = {
    config_hash = local_file.adguard_config.content_md5
  }
  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = ["docker restart adguard || true"]
    connection {
      type        = "ssh"
      user        = "root"
      host        = module.network_services.ip_address
      private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }
  }
  depends_on = [filesync_file.adguard_config]
}

# Outputs
output "dns_mode" {
  description = "Current DNS mode (home=LAN IPs, travel=container IPs for Tailscale)"
  value       = var.dns_mode
}

output "dns_traefik_ip" {
  description = "IP address that AdGuard returns for *.homelab.rambtech.dev"
  value       = local.adguard_traefik_ip
}
```

### `tasks/tofu.yml`
Added DNS toggle tasks with REMOTE option for Tailscale IPs:

dns:home:
  desc: "Switch DNS to HOME mode (LAN IPs - no Tailscale required at home). Use REMOTE=true if not on home network."
  dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/network-services"
  vars:

    - echo "🏠 Switching DNS to HOME mode (192.168.1.x)..."

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
      # 103 reserved for monitoring migration from 500
      container_mgmt   = "10.100.1.104"  # LXC 104 - Pulse + Arcane
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth (deprecated - migrating to authentik)
      authentik  = "10.100.2.203"  # LXC 203 - Identity Provider (replaces Authelia)
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    authelia         = "192.168.1.225"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
    monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Monitoring stack
    openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
    n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
    104 = local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia
    203 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy (HTTP)", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy UI", port = 12345, info = "Alloy debug UI" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]

# Tailscale DNS Resolution Investigation & Fix

## Problem
`*.homelab.rambtech.dev` URLs are not accessible when traveling (remote from home network).

## Root Cause
**Subnet conflict between home network and remote network**

1. Friend's network uses `192.168.1.0/24` (same as homelab LAN)
2. AdGuard returns `192.168.1.235` (Traefik's LAN IP) for `*.homelab.rambtech.dev`
3. macOS routes `192.168.1.x` to local network (friend's) instead of via Tailscale
4. Even with Tailscale subnet routing enabled and accepted, local routes take priority

**What's working:**
- Tailscale Split DNS → AdGuard (DNS resolves correctly via `100.100.100.100`)
- Tailscale mesh connectivity (devices visible in `tailscale status`)
- Tailscale subnet routing for `10.100.0.0/16` (container network) - **no conflict**
- Tailscale subnet routing for `192.168.1.0/24` (advertised & approved, but conflicts with local)

**What's NOT working:**
- `192.168.1.0/24` route conflicts with friend's local network
- macOS prefers local `en0` route over Tailscale `utun9` route for same subnet

## Solution: Use Container Network IP (10.100.2.200)

Change AdGuard DNS rewrite to return Traefik's **container network IP** instead of LAN IP.

### Why This Works
- `10.100.0.0/16` is routed through Tailscale with no conflicts
- Traefik listens on both interfaces (container + LAN)
- Home LAN devices can still reach `10.100.2.200` via Proxmox bridge
- Remote devices route through Tailscale → `10.100.2.200`

### Verification (Already Tested)
```bash
# Routing works via Tailscale
$ netstat -rn | grep "10.100"
10.100/16          link#28            UCS                 utun9

# Ping works
$ ping -c 2 10.100.2.200
2 packets transmitted, 2 packets received, 0.0% packet loss

# HTTPS works
$ curl -vk https://10.100.2.200 -H "Host: homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev"
HTTP/2 200
```

## Fix Implementation

### File to Modify
`tofu/apps/network-services/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml`

### Change
```yaml
rewrites:
  # Change from 192.168.1.235 to 10.100.2.200
  - domain: '*.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    answer: 10.100.2.200
    enabled: true

  # Update exceptions to use container IPs as well
  - domain: pve.homelab.rambtech.dev
    answer: 10.100.2.200  # Or keep pointing to PVE directly
    enabled: true
  - domain: adguard.homelab.rambtech.dev
    answer: 10.100.1.101  # AdGuard's container IP
    enabled: true
  - domain: dns.homelab.rambtech.dev
    answer: 10.100.1.101
    enabled: true
```

### Deploy
```bash
# Sync AdGuard config
./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

# Test
dig homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev @192.168.1.196
# Should return 10.100.2.200

curl https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
# Should work from remote location
```

## Summary

| Scenario | DNS Response | Route | Result |
|----------|--------------|-------|--------|
| Home LAN (Tailscale ON) | 10.100.2.200 | Tailscale → 10.100.x | ✅ Works |
| Remote (Tailscale ON) | 10.100.2.200 | Tailscale → 10.100.x | ✅ Works |
| Remote on conflicting subnet | 10.100.2.200 | Tailscale → 10.100.x | ✅ Works |

## Approach: Toggle Between Home/Travel Modes

Instead of always using container IPs, create a toggle mechanism:

### Files to Create/Modify

1. **Keep existing config for home mode:**
   `tofu/apps/network-services/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml`
   - Uses `192.168.1.235` (LAN IP)
   - Works without Tailscale on home network

2. **Create travel config:**
   `tofu/apps/network-services/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.travel.yaml`
   - Uses `10.100.2.200` (container IP)
   - Works via Tailscale from anywhere

3. **Extend sync script:**
   `scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh`
   - Add `home` command - pushes base config
   - Add `travel` command - pushes travel config

### Usage

```bash
# Before leaving home
./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh travel

# When returning home
./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh home
```

### Implementation Details

**adguard-sync.sh additions:**
```bash
home)
    echo "Switching to HOME mode (LAN IPs)..."
    # Push base AdGuardHome.yaml
    ;;
travel)
    echo "Switching to TRAVEL mode (Container IPs)..."
    # Push AdGuardHome.travel.yaml as AdGuardHome.yaml
    ;;
```

**AdGuardHome.travel.yaml rewrites section:**
```yaml
rewrites:
  - domain: '*.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    answer: 10.100.2.200
    enabled: true
```

### Requirement When Traveling

When in travel mode, ensure:
- Tailscale running on devices
- "Use Tailscale subnets" enabled (accept-routes)

# Refactor Symlinked Files to Shared Common Module

## Goal
Convert the 4 symlinked files (`shared.tf`, `onepassword.tf`, `ip-registry.tf`, `versions.tf`) into a proper Terraform module with clean exports.

## Current State
- 4 symlinked `.tf` files across 15 apps
- Each app references: `local.op.*`, `local.ip_registry.*`, `local.lan_ips.*`, `local.network.*`, `local.agent_tokens[*]`, `local.traefik_ip`, `local.ssh_public_key`
- Providers configured in `versions.tf` (must stay at root level)

## Target State

### Reference Pattern Change
```hcl
# Before (symlinked locals)
local.op.grafana_admin_password
local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
local.lan_ips.traefik
local.network.container_netmask
local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token

# After (module outputs)
module.config.op.grafana_admin_password
module.config.ip.monitoring.monitoring
module.config.lan_ips.traefik
module.config.network.container_netmask
module.config.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
```

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Create Module Structure
```
tofu/modules/config/
├── main.tf           # Module entry point
├── variables.tf      # Input variables (dns_mode, etc.)
├── outputs.tf        # All exports
├── onepassword.tf    # 1Password data sources & op map
├── ip-registry.tf    # IP registry, lan_ips, network
└── versions.tf       # Required providers (for module)
```

### Step 2: Module Files

**`tofu/modules/config/variables.tf`**
```hcl
variable "dns_mode" {
  type    = string
  default = "home"
  validation {
    condition     = contains(["home", "travel"], var.dns_mode)
    error_message = "dns_mode must be 'home' or 'travel'"
  }
}

variable "ssh_public_key_path" {
  type    = string
  default = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519.pub"
}
```

**`tofu/modules/config/outputs.tf`**
```hcl
# 1Password secrets
output "op" {
  description = "1Password secrets"
  value       = local.op
  sensitive   = true
}

# IP registry by category
output "ip" {
  description = "Container IPs by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

# LAN IPs for dual-NIC services
output "lan_ips" {
  value = local.lan_ips
}

# Network config
output "network" {
  value = local.network
}

# Agent tokens
output "agent_tokens" {
  value     = local.agent_tokens
  sensitive = true
}

# Convenience
output "traefik_ip" {
  value = local.lan_ips.traefik
}

output "ssh_public_key" {
  value = file(var.ssh_public_key_path)
}
```

### Step 3: Keep Symlinked (Provider Config)
These stay as symlinks because providers must be at root level:
- `versions.tf` → Provider configurations + terraform block
- `shared.tf` → Variables that need TF_VAR_ input (state_encryption_passphrase, proxmox_*, etc.)

### Step 4: Update App Usage

**Before (in each app's main.tf):**
```hcl
# Uses symlinked locals directly
container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"
grafana_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
```

**After:**
```hcl
# Add module reference
module "config" {
  source = "../../modules/config"
}

# Use module outputs
container_ip = "${module.config.ip.monitoring.monitoring}${module.config.network.container_netmask}"
grafana_password = module.config.op.grafana_admin_password
```

### Step 5: Migration Order

1. Create `tofu/modules/config/` with all files
2. Test on one app (monitoring)
3. Run `tofu init` and `tofu plan` to verify no changes
4. Update remaining 14 apps
5. Remove old symlinks: `ip-registry.tf`, `onepassword.tf` from each app
6. Keep `shared.tf` and `versions.tf` symlinks (still needed)

## Files to Create

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `tofu/modules/config/main.tf` | Empty or placeholder |
| `tofu/modules/config/variables.tf` | dns_mode, ssh_public_key_path |
| `tofu/modules/config/outputs.tf` | All exports (op, ip, lan_ips, network, etc.) |
| `tofu/modules/config/onepassword.tf` | Copy from `tofu/onepassword.tf` |
| `tofu/modules/config/ip-registry.tf` | Copy from `tofu/ip-registry.tf` (remove outputs) |
| `tofu/modules/config/versions.tf` | Just required_providers (no terraform block) |

## Files to Modify (15 apps)

Each app needs:
1. Add `module "config" { source = "../../modules/config" }`
2. Replace all `local.op.*` → `module.config.op.*`
3. Replace all `local.ip_registry.*` → `module.config.ip.*`
4. Replace all `local.lan_ips.*` → `module.config.lan_ips.*`
5. Replace all `local.network.*` → `module.config.network.*`
6. Replace all `local.agent_tokens[*]` → `module.config.agent_tokens[*]`
7. Replace all `local.traefik_ip` → `module.config.traefik_ip`
8. Replace all `local.ssh_public_key` → `module.config.ssh_public_key`
9. Remove symlinks: `rm ip-registry.tf onepassword.tf`

## Files to Keep as Symlinks

- `shared.tf` - Variables requiring TF_VAR_ input
- `versions.tf` - Provider configs (must be at root)

## Verification

For each app after migration:
```bash
cd tofu/apps/<app>
tofu init -upgrade
tofu plan  # Should show no changes
```

# Refactor Symlinked Files to Shared Common Module

## Goal
Convert the 4 symlinked files (`shared.tf`, `onepassword.tf`, `ip-registry.tf`, `versions.tf`) into a proper Terraform module with clean exports.

## Current State
- 4 symlinked `.tf` files across 15 apps
- Each app references: `local.op.*`, `local.ip_registry.*`, `local.lan_ips.*`, `local.network.*`, `local.agent_tokens[*]`, `local.traefik_ip`, `local.ssh_public_key`
- Providers configured in `versions.tf` (must stay at root level)

## Target State

### Reference Pattern Change
```hcl
# Before (symlinked locals)
local.op.grafana_admin_password
local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
local.lan_ips.traefik
local.network.container_netmask
local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token

# After (module outputs)
module.config.op.grafana_admin_password
module.config.ip.monitoring.monitoring
module.config.lan_ips.traefik
module.config.network.container_netmask
module.config.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
```

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Create Module Structure
```
tofu/modules/config/
├── main.tf           # Module entry point
├── variables.tf      # Input variables (dns_mode, etc.)
├── outputs.tf        # All exports
├── onepassword.tf    # 1Password data sources & op map
├── ip-registry.tf    # IP registry, lan_ips, network
└── versions.tf       # Required providers (for module)
```

### Step 2: Module Files

**`tofu/modules/config/variables.tf`**
```hcl
variable "dns_mode" {
  type    = string
  default = "home"
  validation {
    condition     = contains(["home", "travel"], var.dns_mode)
    error_message = "dns_mode must be 'home' or 'travel'"
  }
}

variable "ssh_public_key_path" {
  type    = string
  default = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519.pub"
}
```

**`tofu/modules/config/outputs.tf`**
```hcl
# 1Password secrets
output "op" {
  description = "1Password secrets"
  value       = local.op
  sensitive   = true
}

# IP registry by category
output "ip" {
  description = "Container IPs by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

# LAN IPs for dual-NIC services
output "lan_ips" {
  value = local.lan_ips
}

# Network config
output "network" {
  value = local.network
}

# Agent tokens
output "agent_tokens" {
  value     = local.agent_tokens
  sensitive = true
}

# Convenience
output "traefik_ip" {
  value = local.lan_ips.traefik
}

output "ssh_public_key" {
  value = file(var.ssh_public_key_path)
}
```

### Step 3: Keep Symlinked (Provider Config)
These stay as symlinks because providers must be at root level:
- `versions.tf` → Provider configurations + terraform block
- `shared.tf` → Variables that need TF_VAR_ input (state_encryption_passphrase, proxmox_*, etc.)

### Step 4: Update App Usage

**Before (in each app's main.tf):**
```hcl
# Uses symlinked locals directly
container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"
grafana_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
```

**After:**
```hcl
# Add module reference
module "config" {
  source = "../../modules/config"
}

# Use module outputs
container_ip = "${module.config.ip.monitoring.monitoring}${module.config.network.container_netmask}"
grafana_password = module.config.op.grafana_admin_password
```

### Step 5: Migration Order

1. Create `tofu/modules/config/` with all files
2. Test on one app (monitoring)
3. Run `tofu init` and `tofu plan` to verify no changes
4. Update remaining 14 apps
5. Remove old symlinks: `ip-registry.tf`, `onepassword.tf` from each app
6. Keep `shared.tf` and `versions.tf` symlinks (still needed)

## Files to Create

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `tofu/modules/config/main.tf` | Empty or placeholder |
| `tofu/modules/config/variables.tf` | dns_mode, ssh_public_key_path |
| `tofu/modules/config/outputs.tf` | All exports (op, ip, lan_ips, network, etc.) |
| `tofu/modules/config/onepassword.tf` | Copy from `tofu/onepassword.tf` |
| `tofu/modules/config/ip-registry.tf` | Copy from `tofu/ip-registry.tf` (remove outputs) |
| `tofu/modules/config/versions.tf` | Just required_providers (no terraform block) |

## Files to Modify (15 apps)

Each app needs:
1. Add `module "config" { source = "../../modules/config" }`
2. Replace all `local.op.*` → `module.config.op.*`
3. Replace all `local.ip_registry.*` → `module.config.ip.*`
4. Replace all `local.lan_ips.*` → `module.config.lan_ips.*`
5. Replace all `local.network.*` → `module.config.network.*`
6. Replace all `local.agent_tokens[*]` → `module.config.agent_tokens[*]`
7. Replace all `local.traefik_ip` → `module.config.traefik_ip`
8. Replace all `local.ssh_public_key` → `module.config.ssh_public_key`
9. Remove symlinks: `rm ip-registry.tf onepassword.tf`

## Files to Keep as Symlinks

- `shared.tf` - Variables requiring TF_VAR_ input
- `versions.tf` - Provider configs (must be at root)

## Verification

For each app after migration:
```bash
cd tofu/apps/<app>
tofu init -upgrade
tofu plan  # Should show no changes
```

# Tailscale DNS Resolution Investigation & Fix

## Problem
`*.homelab.rambtech.dev` URLs are not accessible when traveling (remote from home network).

## Root Cause
**Subnet conflict between home network and remote network**

1. Friend's network uses `192.168.1.0/24` (same as homelab LAN)
2. AdGuard returns `192.168.1.235` (Traefik's LAN IP) for `*.homelab.rambtech.dev`
3. macOS routes `192.168.1.x` to local network (friend's) instead of via Tailscale
4. Even with Tailscale subnet routing enabled and accepted, local routes take priority

**What's working:**
- Tailscale Split DNS → AdGuard (DNS resolves correctly via `100.100.100.100`)
- Tailscale mesh connectivity (devices visible in `tailscale status`)
- Tailscale subnet routing for `10.100.0.0/16` (container network) - **no conflict**
- Tailscale subnet routing for `192.168.1.0/24` (advertised & approved, but conflicts with local)

**What's NOT working:**
- `192.168.1.0/24` route conflicts with friend's local network
- macOS prefers local `en0` route over Tailscale `utun9` route for same subnet

## Solution: Use Container Network IP (10.100.2.200)

Change AdGuard DNS rewrite to return Traefik's **container network IP** instead of LAN IP.

### Why This Works
- `10.100.0.0/16` is routed through Tailscale with no conflicts
- Traefik listens on both interfaces (container + LAN)
- Home LAN devices can still reach `10.100.2.200` via Proxmox bridge
- Remote devices route through Tailscale → `10.100.2.200`

### Verification (Already Tested)
```bash
# Routing works via Tailscale
$ netstat -rn | grep "10.100"
10.100/16          link#28            UCS                 utun9

# Ping works
$ ping -c 2 10.100.2.200
2 packets transmitted, 2 packets received, 0.0% packet loss

# HTTPS works
$ curl -vk https://10.100.2.200 -H "Host: homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev"
HTTP/2 200
```

## Fix Implementation

### File to Modify
`tofu/apps/network-services/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml`

### Change
```yaml
rewrites:
  # Change from 192.168.1.235 to 10.100.2.200
  - domain: '*.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    answer: 10.100.2.200
    enabled: true

  # Update exceptions to use container IPs as well
  - domain: pve.homelab.rambtech.dev
    answer: 10.100.2.200  # Or keep pointing to PVE directly
    enabled: true
  - domain: adguard.homelab.rambtech.dev
    answer: 10.100.1.101  # AdGuard's container IP
    enabled: true
  - domain: dns.homelab.rambtech.dev
    answer: 10.100.1.101
    enabled: true
```

### Deploy
```bash
# Sync AdGuard config
./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

# Test
dig homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev @192.168.1.196
# Should return 10.100.2.200

curl https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
# Should work from remote location
```

## Summary

| Scenario | DNS Response | Route | Result |
|----------|--------------|-------|--------|
| Home LAN (Tailscale ON) | 10.100.2.200 | Tailscale → 10.100.x | ✅ Works |
| Remote (Tailscale ON) | 10.100.2.200 | Tailscale → 10.100.x | ✅ Works |
| Remote on conflicting subnet | 10.100.2.200 | Tailscale → 10.100.x | ✅ Works |

## Approach: Toggle Between Home/Travel Modes

Instead of always using container IPs, create a toggle mechanism:

### Files to Create/Modify

1. **Keep existing config for home mode:**
   `tofu/apps/network-services/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml`
   - Uses `192.168.1.235` (LAN IP)
   - Works without Tailscale on home network

2. **Create travel config:**
   `tofu/apps/network-services/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.travel.yaml`
   - Uses `10.100.2.200` (container IP)
   - Works via Tailscale from anywhere

3. **Extend sync script:**
   `scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh`
   - Add `home` command - pushes base config
   - Add `travel` command - pushes travel config

### Usage

```bash
# Before leaving home
./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh travel

# When returning home
./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh home
```

### Implementation Details

**adguard-sync.sh additions:**
```bash
home)
    echo "Switching to HOME mode (LAN IPs)..."
    # Push base AdGuardHome.yaml
    ;;
travel)
    echo "Switching to TRAVEL mode (Container IPs)..."
    # Push AdGuardHome.travel.yaml as AdGuardHome.yaml
    ;;
```

**AdGuardHome.travel.yaml rewrites section:**
```yaml
rewrites:
  - domain: '*.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    answer: 10.100.2.200
    enabled: true
```

### Requirement When Traveling

When in travel mode, ensure:
- Tailscale running on devices
- "Use Tailscale subnets" enabled (accept-routes)

input.content:
# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
      # 103 reserved for monitoring migration from 500
      container_mgmt   = "10.100.1.104"  # LXC 104 - Pulse + Arcane
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth (deprecated - migrating to authentik)
      authentik  = "10.100.2.203"  # LXC 203 - Identity Provider (replaces Authelia)
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    authelia         = "192.168.1.225"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
    monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Monitoring stack
    openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
    n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
    104 = local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia
    203 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

    n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
    104 = local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia
    203 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
