   110→3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO
   111→
   112→## Forward Auth Endpoint
   113→
   114→Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
   115→```yaml
   116→middlewares:
   117→  authentik:
   118→    forwardAuth:
   119→      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
   120→      trustForwardHeader: true
   121→      authResponseHeaders:
   122→        - X-authentik-username
   123→        - X-authentik-groups
   124→        - X-authentik-email
   125→        - X-authentik-name
   126→        - X-authentik-uid
   127→        - X-authentik-jwt
   128→        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
   129→        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
   130→        - X-authentik-meta-provider
   131→        - X-authentik-meta-app
   132→        - X-authentik-meta-version
   133→```
   134→
   135→## Quick Commands
   136→
   137→```bash
   138→# View server logs
   139→docker logs -f authentik-server
   140→
   141→# View worker logs
   142→docker logs -f authentik-worker
   143→
   144→# Database backup
   145→docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql
   146→
   147→# Restart services
   148→cd /config && docker compose restart
   149→```
   150→
   151→## OIDC Configuration
   152→
   153→For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
   154→1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
   155→2. Set redirect URI for the app
   156→3. Create Application linking to the provider
   157→4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config
   158→
   159→## Managed by OpenTofu
   160→
   161→Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
   162→EOT
   163→
   164→  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
   165→}
   166→
   167→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   168→# Create .env file with secrets
   169→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   170→# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container
   171→
   172→resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
   173→  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
   174→    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
   175→    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
   176→    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
   177→    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
   178→  })
   179→  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
   180→  file_permission = "0600"
   181→}
   182→
   183→resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
   184→  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
   185→  destination = "/config/.env"
   186→  host        = module.authentik.ip_address
   187→
   188→  mode = "0600"
   189→
   190→  depends_on = [module.authentik]
   191→}
   192→
   193→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   194→# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
   195→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   196→
   197→module "authentik_route" {
   198→  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"
   199→
   200→  app_name    = "authentik"
   201→  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"
   202→
   203→  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
   204→  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
   205→  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"
   206→
   207→  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
   208→  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"
   209→
   210→  # Traefik config
   211→  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
   212→  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
   213→
   214→  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
   215→  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
   216→  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
   217→  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
   218→  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]
   219→
   220→  depends_on = [module.authentik]
   221→}
   222→
   223→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   224→# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
   225→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   226→# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik
   227→
   228→resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
   229→  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
   230→    domain_public = var.domain_public
   231→  })
   232→  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
   233→}
   234→
   235→resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
   236→  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
   237→  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
   238→  host        = local.traefik_ip
   239→
   240→  mode = "0644"
   241→
   242→  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
   243→}
   244→
   245→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   246→# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
   247→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   248→# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
   249→# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
   250→#
   251→# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
   252→# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.
   253→
   254→data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
   255→  username = "akadmin"
   256→}
   257→
   258→resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
   259→  identifier   = "terraform-api"
   260→  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
   261→  intent       = "api"
   262→  expiring     = false  # Never expires
   263→  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
   264→}
   265→
   266→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   267→# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
   268→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   269→# Allows users to login with their Google account
   270→# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)
   271→
   272→data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
   273→  slug = "default-source-authentication"
   274→}
   275→
   276→resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
   277→  name                = "Google"
   278→  slug                = "google"
   279→  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id
   280→
   281→  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
   282→  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
   283→  enrollment_flow = ""
   284→
   285→  provider_type   = "google"
   286→  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
   287→  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret
   288→
   289→  # Match users by email identifier
   290→  user_matching_mode = "identifier"
   291→
   292→  # Policy engine mode
   293→  policy_engine_mode = "any"
   294→}
   295→
   296→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   297→# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
   298→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   299→# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
   300→# in the authentik admin UI:
   301→#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
   302→#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
   303→#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
   304→#   4. Save
   305→#
   306→# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
   307→# via Terraform without importing it first.
   308→
   309→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   310→# Forward Auth Provider - For protecting services via Traefik
   311→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   312→# Creates a Proxy Provider in forward auth mode for protecting services
   313→# that don't have native OIDC support. The embedded outpost handles the auth.
   314→
   315→data "authentik_flow" "default_authorization" {
   316→  slug = "default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent"
   317→}
   318→
   319→data "authentik_flow" "default_invalidation" {
   320→  slug = "default-provider-invalidation-flow"
   321→}
   322→
   323→resource "authentik_provider_proxy" "forward_auth" {
   324→  name               = "Traefik Forward Auth"
   325→  mode               = "forward_single"  # Single application mode for forward auth
   326→  authorization_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_authorization.id
   327→  invalidation_flow  = data.authentik_flow.default_invalidation.id
   328→
   329→  # External host - Traefik sends X-Forwarded-* headers with the original request
   330→  external_host = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
   331→
   332→  # Cookie settings for SSO across all homelab subdomains
   333→  cookie_domain = var.domain_internal
   334→}
   335→
   336→resource "authentik_application" "forward_auth" {
   337→  name              = "Homelab Forward Auth"
   338→  slug              = "homelab-forward-auth"
   339→  protocol_provider = authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id
   340→
   341→  meta_description = "Forward authentication for homelab services protected by Traefik"
   342→  meta_publisher   = "Homelab Infrastructure"
   343→
   344→  # Open to all authenticated users
   345→  policy_engine_mode = "any"
   346→}
   347→
   348→# Update the embedded outpost to include the forward auth provider
   349→# Note: The embedded outpost is managed by authentik, we just update its providers
   350→resource "authentik_outpost" "embedded" {
   351→  name               = "authentik Embedded Outpost"
   352→  type               = "proxy"
   353→  protocol_providers = [authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id]
   354→
   355→  config = jsonencode({
   356→    authentik_host          = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
   357→    authentik_host_browser  = ""
   358→    authentik_host_insecure = false
   359→    log_level               = "info"
   360→  })
   361→
   362→  lifecycle {
   363→    # The embedded outpost already exists, we're just updating it
   364→    ignore_changes = [service_connection]
   365→  }
   366→}
   367→
   368→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   369→# Users - Managed via SOPS encrypted file
   370→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   371→# Users who can login via Google OAuth. Email must match their Google account.
   372→# Edit with: sops edit tofu/apps/authentik/users.sops.yaml
   373→
   374→data "sops_file" "users" {
   375→  source_file = "${path.module}/users.sops.yaml"
   376→}
   377→
   378→locals {
   379→  # User data is encrypted at rest but not truly secret - it's just user info
   380→  # Using nonsensitive() so we can iterate with for_each
   381→  authentik_users = nonsensitive(yamldecode(data.sops_file.users.raw).authentik_users)
   382→}
   383→
   384→resource "authentik_user" "users" {
   385→  for_each = local.authentik_users
   386→
   387→  username = each.key
   388→  email    = each.value.email
   389→  name     = each.value.name
   390→
   391→  # Users authenticate via Google OAuth, no local password needed
   392→  # They can set one later if desired via the user portal
   393→}
   394→
   395→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   396→# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
   397→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   398→
   399→module "authentik_sidecars" {
   400→  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"
   401→
   402→  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
   403→  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
   404→  container_name = "authentik"
   405→
   406→  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
   407→  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
   408→
   409→  backup = {
   410→    enabled   = true
   411→    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
   412→    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
   413→    namespace = "lxc-203"
   414→
   415→    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
   416→    pre_backup_commands = [
   417→      {
   418→        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
   419→        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
   420→        timeout = 120
   421→      }
   422→    ]
   423→
   424→    include_paths = ["/config"]
   425→    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]
   426→
   427→    ntfy_priority = "default"
   428→    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
   429→  }
   430→
   431→  # Container monitoring agents
   432→  pulse_agent = {
   433→    enabled     = true
   434→    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
   435→  }
   436→
   437→  arcane_agent = {
   438→    enabled         = true
   439→    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
   440→  }
   441→
   442→  alloy_agent = {
   443→    enabled  = true
   444→    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
   445→    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
   446→  }
   447→
   448→  depends_on = [module.authentik]
   449→}
   450→
   451→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   452→# Outputs
   453→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   454→
   455→output "container_id" {
   456→  value = module.authentik.container_id
   457→}
   458→
   459→output "ip_address" {
   460→  value = module.authentik.ip_address
   461→}
   462→
   463→output "ssh_command" {
   464→  value = module.authentik.ssh_command
   465→}
   466→
   467→output "urls" {
   468→  value = {
   469→    admin  = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
   470→    user   = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
   471→    direct = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"
   472→  }
   473→}
   474→
   475→output "traefik_config_path" {
   476→  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
   477→  value       = module.authentik_route.remote_config_path
   478→}
   479→
   480→output "terraform_api_token" {
   481→  description = "API token for Terraform - update 1Password with this value"
   482→  value       = authentik_token.terraform.key
   483→  sensitive   = true
   484→}
   485→
   486→output "forward_auth_url" {
   487→  description = "URL for Traefik forwardAuth middleware"
   488→  value       = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik"

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    domain_public = var.domain_public
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
#
# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.

data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
  username = "akadmin"
}

resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
  identifier   = "terraform-api"
  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
  intent       = "api"
  expiring     = false  # Never expires
  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id

  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
  enrollment_flow = ""

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Match users by email identifier
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
# in the authentik admin UI:
#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
#   4. Save
#
# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
# via Terraform without importing it first.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Forward Auth Provider - For protecting services via Traefik
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a Proxy Provider in forward auth mode for protecting services
# that don't have native OIDC support. The embedded outpost handles the auth.

data "authentik_flow" "default_authorization" {
  slug = "default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_invalidation" {
  slug = "default-provider-invalidation-flow"

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# File Structure:
#   - main.tf:      Container, env, routes, sidecars
#   - providers.tf: OAuth sources, forward auth, OIDC providers
#   - users.tf:     User management (SOPS-encrypted)
#   - outputs.tf:   All outputs
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    domain_public = var.domain_public
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# File Structure:
#   - main.tf:      Container, env, routes, sidecars
#   - providers.tf: OAuth sources, forward auth, OIDC providers
#   - users.tf:     User management (SOPS-encrypted)
#   - outputs.tf:   All outputs
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    domain_public = var.domain_public
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)

  # Resources

  memory = var.memory

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"

  }

    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },

  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

}

# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)

  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)

  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {

    domain_public = var.domain_public
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
#
# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.

data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
  username = "akadmin"
}

resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
  identifier   = "terraform-api"
  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
  intent       = "api"
  expiring     = false  # Never expires
  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id

  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
  enrollment_flow = ""

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Match users by email identifier
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
# in the authentik admin UI:
#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
#   4. Save
#
# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
# via Terraform without importing it first.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Forward Auth Provider - For protecting services via Traefik
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a Proxy Provider in forward auth mode for protecting services
# that don't have native OIDC support. The embedded outpost handles the auth.

data "authentik_flow" "default_authorization" {
  slug = "default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_invalidation" {
  slug = "default-provider-invalidation-flow"
}

resource "authentik_provider_proxy" "forward_auth" {
  name               = "Traefik Forward Auth"
  mode               = "forward_single"  # Single application mode for forward auth
  authorization_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_authorization.id
  invalidation_flow  = data.authentik_flow.default_invalidation.id

  # External host - Traefik sends X-Forwarded-* headers with the original request
  external_host = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Cookie settings for SSO across all homelab subdomains
  cookie_domain = var.domain_internal
}

resource "authentik_application" "forward_auth" {
  name              = "Homelab Forward Auth"
  slug              = "homelab-forward-auth"
  protocol_provider = authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id

  meta_description = "Forward authentication for homelab services protected by Traefik"
  meta_publisher   = "Homelab Infrastructure"

  # Open to all authenticated users
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# Update the embedded outpost to include the forward auth provider
# Note: The embedded outpost is managed by authentik, we just update its providers
resource "authentik_outpost" "embedded" {
  name               = "authentik Embedded Outpost"
  type               = "proxy"
  protocol_providers = [authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id]

  config = jsonencode({
    authentik_host          = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
    authentik_host_browser  = ""
    authentik_host_insecure = false
    log_level               = "info"
  })

  lifecycle {
    # The embedded outpost already exists, we're just updating it
    ignore_changes = [service_connection]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  source_file = "${path.module}/users.sops.yaml"
}

  authentik_users = nonsensitive(yamldecode(data.sops_file.users.raw).authentik_users)
}

  for_each = local.authentik_users

  username = each.key
  email    = each.value.email
  name     = each.value.name

  # They can set one later if desired via the user portal
}

# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authentik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authentik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authentik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    admin  = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user   = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"
  }
}

  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authentik_route.remote_config_path
}

  description = "API token for Terraform - update 1Password with this value"
  value       = authentik_token.terraform.key

}

  description = "URL for Traefik forwardAuth middleware"

}

     3→# =============================================================================
     4→# This file contains all Authentik provider configurations:
     5→#   - Google OAuth source (SSO via Google)
     6→#   - Forward auth provider for Traefik
     7→#   - OIDC providers for apps with native SSO support (future)
     8→# =============================================================================
     9→
    10→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    11→# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
    12→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    13→# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
    14→# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
    15→#
    16→# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
    17→# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.
    18→
    19→data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
    20→  username = "akadmin"
    21→}
    22→
    23→resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
    24→  identifier   = "terraform-api"
    25→  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
    26→  intent       = "api"
    27→  expiring     = false  # Never expires
    28→  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
    29→}
    30→
    31→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32→# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
    33→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    34→# Allows users to login with their Google account
    35→# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)
    36→
    37→data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
    38→  slug = "default-source-authentication"
    39→}
    40→
    41→resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
    42→  name                = "Google"
    43→  slug                = "google"
    44→  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id
    45→
    46→  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
    47→  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
    48→  enrollment_flow = ""
    49→
    50→  provider_type   = "google"
    51→  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
    52→  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret
    53→
    54→  # Match users by email identifier
    55→  user_matching_mode = "identifier"
    56→
    57→  # Policy engine mode
    58→  policy_engine_mode = "any"
    59→}
    60→
    61→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    62→# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
    63→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    64→# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
    65→# in the authentik admin UI:
    66→#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
    67→#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
    68→#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
    69→#   4. Save
    70→#
    71→# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
    72→# via Terraform without importing it first.
    73→
    74→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    75→# Forward Auth Provider - For protecting services via Traefik
    76→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    77→# Creates a Proxy Provider in forward auth mode for protecting services
    78→# that don't have native OIDC support. The embedded outpost handles the auth.
    79→
    80→data "authentik_flow" "default_authorization" {
    81→  slug = "default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent"
    82→}
    83→
    84→data "authentik_flow" "default_invalidation" {
    85→  slug = "default-provider-invalidation-flow"
    86→}
    87→
    88→resource "authentik_provider_proxy" "forward_auth" {
    89→  name               = "Traefik Forward Auth"
    90→  mode               = "forward_single"  # Single application mode for forward auth
    91→  authorization_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_authorization.id
    92→  invalidation_flow  = data.authentik_flow.default_invalidation.id
    93→

# =============================================================================
# Authentik Providers - OAuth Sources, Forward Auth, OIDC Providers
# =============================================================================
# This file contains all Authentik provider configurations:
#   - Google OAuth source (SSO via Google)
#   - Forward auth provider for Traefik
#   - OIDC providers for apps with native SSO support (future)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
#
# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.

data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
  username = "akadmin"
}

resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
  identifier   = "terraform-api"
  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
  intent       = "api"
  expiring     = false  # Never expires
  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id

  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
  enrollment_flow = ""

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Match users by email identifier
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
# in the authentik admin UI:
#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
#   4. Save
#
# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
# via Terraform without importing it first.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Forward Auth Provider - For protecting services via Traefik
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a Proxy Provider in forward auth mode for protecting services
# that don't have native OIDC support. The embedded outpost handles the auth.

data "authentik_flow" "default_authorization" {
  slug = "default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_invalidation" {
  slug = "default-provider-invalidation-flow"
}

resource "authentik_provider_proxy" "forward_auth" {
  name               = "Traefik Forward Auth"
  mode               = "forward_single"  # Single application mode for forward auth
  authorization_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_authorization.id
  invalidation_flow  = data.authentik_flow.default_invalidation.id

  # External host - Traefik sends X-Forwarded-* headers with the original request
  external_host = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Cookie settings for SSO across all homelab subdomains
  cookie_domain = var.domain_internal
}

resource "authentik_application" "forward_auth" {
  name              = "Homelab Forward Auth"
  slug              = "homelab-forward-auth"
  protocol_provider = authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id

  meta_description = "Forward authentication for homelab services protected by Traefik"
  meta_publisher   = "Homelab Infrastructure"

  # Open to all authenticated users
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# Update the embedded outpost to include the forward auth provider
# Note: The embedded outpost is managed by authentik, we just update its providers
resource "authentik_outpost" "embedded" {
  name               = "authentik Embedded Outpost"
  type               = "proxy"
  protocol_providers = [authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id]

  config = jsonencode({
    authentik_host          = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
    authentik_host_browser  = ""
    authentik_host_insecure = false
    log_level               = "info"
  })

  lifecycle {
    # The embedded outpost already exists, we're just updating it
    ignore_changes = [service_connection]
  }
}

content.text:
I see the issue. The `cookie_domain` is set to `var.domain_internal` which is `homelab.rambtech.dev`, but the auth URL is `auth.rambtech.dev` (public domain). This creates a domain mismatch.

For forward auth to work properly across subdomains, the cookie domain should be the parent domain that's common to both the auth server and the protected services. Since Homepage is at `homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev` and auth is at `auth.rambtech.dev`, the cookie domain should be `rambtech.dev` (the root domain).

Let me fix this:

  # Must be the root domain to work with both *.homelab.rambtech.dev and auth.rambtech.dev
  cookie_domain = var.domain_public

The public route `auth.rambtech.dev` uses the `web` entrypoint (HTTP port 80) because Cloudflare handles TLS termination and forwards HTTP to the origin. This is correct for the Cloudflare tunnel setup.

The issue is in the JWT state - it's encoding `http://auth.rambtech.dev` as the redirect. This happens because the forward auth provider's `external_host` is used to generate callbacks. Let me check if the issue is the provider needs to know about the browser-facing URL being HTTPS even though traffic arrives via HTTP.

Looking at the Authentik proxy provider, we need to ensure the redirect uses HTTPS. The issue is that Traefik sees the request coming in on HTTP (from Cloudflare), so Authentik generates HTTP redirects.

I see the issue now. When Cloudflare proxies requests to Traefik, it sends `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` but the Authentik middleware might not be receiving it correctly, or the outpost is using the wrong scheme for redirects.

Looking at the state JWT again: `"redirect":"http://auth.rambtech.dev"` - this is in the OAuth state parameter, and it's being set by the outpost when generating the authorization URL.

The fix is to set `authentik_host_browser` in the outpost config to tell the outpost what URL browsers should use (which is HTTPS via Cloudflare):

    # Browser URL - what users see (HTTPS via Cloudflare)
    authentik_host_browser  = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
    authentik_host_insecure = false
    log_level               = "info"
  })

# =============================================================================
# Authentik Providers - OAuth Sources, Forward Auth, OIDC Providers
# =============================================================================
# This file contains all Authentik provider configurations:
#   - Google OAuth source (SSO via Google)
#   - Forward auth provider for Traefik
#   - OIDC providers for apps with native SSO support (future)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
#
# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.

data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
  username = "akadmin"
}

resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
  identifier   = "terraform-api"
  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
  intent       = "api"
  expiring     = false  # Never expires
  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id

  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
  enrollment_flow = ""

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Match users by email identifier
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
# in the authentik admin UI:
#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
#   4. Save
#
# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
# via Terraform without importing it first.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Forward Auth Provider - For protecting services via Traefik
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a Proxy Provider in forward auth mode for protecting services
# that don't have native OIDC support. The embedded outpost handles the auth.

data "authentik_flow" "default_authorization" {
  slug = "default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_invalidation" {
  slug = "default-provider-invalidation-flow"
}

resource "authentik_provider_proxy" "forward_auth" {
  name               = "Traefik Forward Auth"
  mode               = "forward_single"  # Single application mode for forward auth
  authorization_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_authorization.id
  invalidation_flow  = data.authentik_flow.default_invalidation.id

  # External host - Traefik sends X-Forwarded-* headers with the original request
  external_host = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Cookie settings for SSO across all subdomains
  # Must be the root domain to work with both *.homelab.rambtech.dev and auth.rambtech.dev
  cookie_domain = var.domain_public
}

resource "authentik_application" "forward_auth" {
  name              = "Homelab Forward Auth"
  slug              = "homelab-forward-auth"
  protocol_provider = authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id

  meta_description = "Forward authentication for homelab services protected by Traefik"
  meta_publisher   = "Homelab Infrastructure"

  # Open to all authenticated users
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# Update the embedded outpost to include the forward auth provider
# Note: The embedded outpost is managed by authentik, we just update its providers
resource "authentik_outpost" "embedded" {
  name               = "authentik Embedded Outpost"
  type               = "proxy"
  protocol_providers = [authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id]

  config = jsonencode({
    authentik_host          = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
    authentik_host_browser  = ""
    authentik_host_insecure = false
    log_level               = "info"
  })

  lifecycle {
    # The embedded outpost already exists, we're just updating it
    ignore_changes = [service_connection]
  }
}

content.text:
The HTTP API calls are being made by the Authentik frontend JavaScript. These are relative API calls that the browser makes based on the current page URL. Since Cloudflare terminates TLS and forwards HTTP to Traefik, the browser sees the page as HTTPS but the frontend code is making relative API calls that get blocked as mixed content.

The issue is that Authentik needs to know it's behind a reverse proxy that handles HTTPS. We need to configure Authentik itself to be aware it's running behind HTTPS. This is done via environment variables in the Authentik container.

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# File Structure:
#   - main.tf:      Container, env, routes, sidecars
#   - providers.tf: OAuth sources, forward auth, OIDC providers
#   - users.tf:     User management (SOPS-encrypted)
#   - outputs.tf:   All outputs
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"

  ]

## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    domain_public = var.domain_public
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}
