content.text:
Great question! It's **limited to users set up in Authentik**, not anyone with a Gmail account.

Here's how the flow works:

1. **User clicks "Login with Google" on Immich**
2. **Immich redirects to Authentik** (the issuer URL)
3. **Authentik checks if the user exists** in its database
4. **If user exists** → Authentik redirects to Google OAuth → back to Authentik → back to Immich with tokens
5. **If user doesn't exist in Authentik** → Login fails (because we disabled enrollment in the Google OAuth source)

Remember in [providers.tf](tofu/apps/authentik/providers.tf) we configured:

```hcl
resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  # ...
  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
  enrollment_flow = ""
  
  # Match users by email and link OAuth source on first login
  user_matching_mode = "email_link"
}
```

So the `autoRegister: true` in Immich only matters **after** Authentik has authenticated the user. Authentik acts as the gatekeeper - only users you've pre-created in Authentik (via `users.tf` or manually) can authenticate.

**Summary:**
- Authentik controls WHO can authenticate (your pre-created users only)
- Immich's `autoRegister` controls whether authenticated users automatically get Immich accounts
sounds good!

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # n8n - Workflow Automation
  # ==========================================================================
  n8n:
    container_name: n8n
    image: n8nio/n8n:2.1.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5678:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_HOST=${N8N_HOST:-n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - N8N_PORT=5678
      - N8N_PROTOCOL=https
      - WEBHOOK_URL=https://${N8N_HOST:-n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev}/
      - GENERIC_TIMEZONE=America/Los_Angeles
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    volumes:
      - n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5678/healthz || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

volumes:
  n8n_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.5.9
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.12.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - --disable-reporting=true
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - |
          bash -c '
          exec 42<>/dev/tcp/localhost/12345;
          echo -e "GET /-/healthy HTTP/1.1\nHost: localhost\nConnection: close\n\n" >&42;
          head -1 <&42 | cut -d" " -f2 | grep -q "^200$" || exit 1;
          exec 42<&-;
          exec 42>&-'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.8.1
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.30.0
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:12.3.1
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.15.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ./ntfy/templates:/etc/ntfy/templates:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  loki_data:
  alloy_data:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    shm_size: 128mb
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.4
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:8080/ | grep -q 'Stirling' || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  paperless-data:
  paperless-media:
  paperless-pgdata:
  paperless-redis-data:
  stirling-tessdata:
  stirling-configs:

4. **OpenWebUI** - **YES supports OIDC** via `OAUTH_*` environment variables

Let me start with **Grafana** since it has the most mature OIDC support and is straightforward to configure. I'll create the `authentik.tf` file for Grafana.

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy (HTTP)", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy UI", port = 12345, info = "Alloy debug UI" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "alloy_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "loki_url" {
  value = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3100"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.5.9
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.12.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - --disable-reporting=true
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - |
          bash -c '
          exec 42<>/dev/tcp/localhost/12345;
          echo -e "GET /-/healthy HTTP/1.1\nHost: localhost\nConnection: close\n\n" >&42;
          head -1 <&42 | cut -d" " -f2 | grep -q "^200$" || exit 1;
          exec 42<&-;
          exec 42>&-'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.8.1
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.30.0
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:12.3.1
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.15.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ./ntfy/templates:/etc/ntfy/templates:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  loki_data:
  alloy_data:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy (HTTP)", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy UI", port = 12345, info = "Alloy debug UI" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "alloy_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "loki_url" {
  value = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3100"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config

```

## Managed by OpenTofu

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "alloy_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "loki_url" {
  value = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3100"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.5.9
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.12.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - --disable-reporting=true
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - |
          bash -c '
          exec 42<>/dev/tcp/localhost/12345;
          echo -e "GET /-/healthy HTTP/1.1\nHost: localhost\nConnection: close\n\n" >&42;
          head -1 <&42 | cut -d" " -f2 | grep -q "^200$" || exit 1;
          exec 42<&-;
          exec 42>&-'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.8.1
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'

# Terraform Configuration for Grafana OIDC with Authentik

## Core Provider Setup

The Terraform provider defines an OAuth2 provider for Grafana with these key components:

**Provider Resource:**
The `authentik_provider_oauth2` resource requires a client ID (generated via `openssl rand -hex 16`) and specifies "a strict redirect URI matching mode" pointing to `https://grafana.company/login/generic_oauth`.

**Property Mappings:**
Three scope mappings are essential:
- OpenID scope mapping
- Email scope mapping  
- Profile scope mapping

These are included in the provider's `property_mappings` list to enable proper user information exchange.

**Application Binding:**
A separate `authentik_application` resource connects to the OAuth2 provider using the `protocol_provider` attribute.

## Group-Based Role Management

The configuration includes three optional group resources for role assignment:
- Grafana Admins
- Grafana Editors
- Grafana Viewers

These groups support Grafana's role-mapping functionality, allowing administrators to control access levels based on group membership during the OAuth flow.

**Key Detail:** The `allowed_redirect_uris` parameter uses strict matching mode to ensure security, preventing open redirect vulnerabilities.

## Search Results Summary

This issue affects Grafana docker image 10.2.1 with auth.generic_oauth enabled, where the first login attempt fails with the specific errors you mentioned.

The error logs show:
"Failed to create user" error="user not found" with auth_module=oauth_generic_oauth, followed by "Failed to run post auth hook" with error "[user.sync.internal] unable to create user: user not found"

### Key Finding
Interestingly, when trying to log in via generic OAuth again, it was successful on the second attempt, and after that the issue was not observed ever again.

This appears to be documented in **GitHub Issue #79836** on the grafana/grafana repository, dated December 22, 2023.

The issue seems to be a race condition or timing issue during the first OAuth login attempt where the user creation process fails, but subsequent attempts succeed. This is a known bug in Grafana's OAuth authentication flow rather than an authentik-specific configuration problem.

If you're experiencing this consistently (not just on first login), you may want to:
1. Check your Grafana version and consider upgrading
2. Review your OAuth configuration in grafana.ini
3. Check for any related issues or fixes in newer Grafana releases

      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.8.1
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.30.0
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:12.3.1
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
      # OAuth/OIDC via Authentik
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ENABLED=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_NAME=Authentik
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_SCOPES=openid email profile
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_AUTH_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_AUTH_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_API_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_API_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_AUTO_LOGIN=false
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_USE_PKCE=true
      - GF_AUTH_SIGNOUT_REDIRECT_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_SIGNOUT_URL}
      # Attribute mappings for user info from Authentik
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=preferred_username
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_NAME_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=name
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=email
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.15.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ./ntfy/templates:/etc/ntfy/templates:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  loki_data:
  alloy_data:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Plus traefik-route module for self-service routing.
# =============================================================================

module "n8n" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = 502

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores          = 2
  memory         = 2048
  swap           = 1024
  rootfs_size    = 8
  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

Based on my search results, here's what I found about n8n OIDC SSO authentication and environment variables:

## Current Status of OIDC Configuration via Environment Variables

n8n supports the SAML and OIDC authentication protocols for single sign-on (SSO). However, there's an important limitation:

**OIDC configuration via environment variables is currently a feature request, not a built-in capability.** Users can configure SSO (OIDC) via the UI following the documentation, but for those who deploy n8n on multiple environments and need to rotate the client ID/client secret from time to time, this is challenging.(no content)There's a feature request to have SSO settings configurable with variables such as N8N_SAML_LOGIN_URL, N8N_SAML_ACS_URL, N8N_SAML_ENTITY_ID, and N8N_SAML_METADATA_URL. The rationale is that with the embedded license it's normal to deploy many n8n instances, and configuring SSO via the GUI or database hacking is inconvenient.

## Key Environment Variables for n8n with OIDC

If you are running n8n behind a load balancer, make sure you set the N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL environment variable.

## OIDC Setup Requirements (via UI)

You need to add an additional scope called n8n to your OIDC authorization server. On this n8n scope, you need to add claims that are always included in the "ID Token" from your authorization server. These two attributes need to be configured in the user groups of your identity provider that have access to n8n.

## Workaround: Community SSO Solution

For those wanting to use OIDC without the enterprise license, there's a community project (n8n-community-sso) that uses oauth2-proxy with environment variables like:
- `EXTERNAL_HOOK_FILES`, `N8N_FORWARD_AUTH_HEADER`, along with OAUTH2_PROXY variables such as `OAUTH2_PROXY_PROVIDER=oidc`, `OAUTH2_PROXY_OIDC_ISSUER_URL`, `OAUTH2_PROXY_CLIENT_ID`, `OAUTH2_PROXY_CLIENT_SECRET`

This solution uses an external oauth2-proxy to handle OIDC authentication before requests reach n8n.

content.text:
Based on my research, **n8n's native OIDC/SSO is an enterprise feature** and cannot be configured via environment variables - it requires UI configuration. 

According to [n8n community discussions](https://community.n8n.io/t/sso-oidc-configuration-via-environment-variables-or-config-file/163195) and [feature requests](https://community.n8n.io/t/add-ability-to-configure-sso-oidc-via-environment-variables/198338), this is a known limitation.

The options are:
1. **Use Authentik forward auth** (like we have for Prometheus/Alertmanager) - protects n8n at the Traefik layer
2. **Enterprise license** - enables native OIDC configuration via UI
3. **Community workaround** - [oauth2-proxy](https://github.com/PavelSozonov/n8n-community-sso) sidecar

Since n8n doesn't support native OIDC via environment variables, I'll skip it and move to **OpenWebUI** which does support OIDC:

# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 501
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Features AMD GPU passthrough for Ollama LLM acceleration.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 501
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 12
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 24576
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OpenWebUI Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "openwebui"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged for security (with GPU passthrough)
  unprivileged = true
  enable_gpu   = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "OpenWebUI"
  service_description = "AI chat interface with Ollama backend (AMD GPU accelerated)"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://ai.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.openwebui}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenWebUI", port = 3000, info = "AI chat interface" },
    { name = "Ollama", port = 11434, info = "LLM backend (ROCM GPU)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M passed through for Ollama LLM acceleration:
- `/dev/kfd`, `/dev/dri` devices
- ROCM backend

**Check GPU:**
```
docker exec ollama rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f openwebui
cd /config && docker compose logs -f ollama
```

**List models:**
```
docker exec ollama ollama list
```

**Pull new model:**
```
docker exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=openwebui` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["openwebui", "ai", "ollama", "llm"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.openwebui.container_id
  container_ip   = module.openwebui.ip_address
  container_name = "openwebui"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-501"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database dump needed - SQLite file backup is sufficient

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2", "/root/.ollama/**"]  # Exclude 32GB of Ollama models

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,openwebui"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["openwebui"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["openwebui"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenWebUI (AI Chat Interface)
module "openwebui_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "openwebui"
  backend_url = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal and public routes (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "ai.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "ai.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# Ollama API (LLM Backend with Basic Auth)
module "ollama_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ollama"
  backend_url = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:11434"

  # Internal only (authenticated API access)
  internal_domain = "ollama.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Basic auth for API access
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "ollama-auth"]

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.openwebui.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.openwebui.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.openwebui.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    openwebui = {
      internal = module.openwebui_route.internal_url
      public   = module.openwebui_route.public_url
      direct   = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"
    }
    ollama = {
      internal = module.ollama_route.internal_url
      direct   = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:11434"
    }
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    openwebui = module.openwebui_route.remote_config_path
    ollama    = module.ollama_route.remote_config_path
  }
}
