# =============================================================================
# Container Management LXC - Pulse + Arcane
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 104
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Container monitoring (Pulse) and management (Arcane).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 104
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Container Management LXC
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "container_mgmt" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "container-mgmt"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - no LAN access needed)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 512

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Container Management"
  service_description = "Pulse monitoring + Arcane container management"

  service_urls = {
    pulse  = "https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}"
    arcane = "https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Pulse", port = 7655, info = "Proxmox + Docker monitoring" },
    { name = "Arcane", port = 3552, info = "Docker container management" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Pulse - Container Monitoring

Real-time monitoring for Proxmox VE and Docker containers.
- Dashboard: https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}
- Proxmox metrics via PVE API
- Docker metrics via socket

## Arcane - Container Management

Docker container management with update detection.
- Dashboard: https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}
- Remote agents connect from other LXCs

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f pulse
cd /config && docker compose logs -f arcane
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=container-mgmt` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["pulse", "arcane", "management"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "local_sensitive_file" "container_mgmt_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    pulse_admin_user      = local.op.pulse_admin_user
    pulse_admin_password  = local.op.pulse_admin_password
    arcane_encryption_key = local.op.arcane_encryption_key
    arcane_jwt_secret     = local.op.arcane_jwt_secret
    # Pulse OIDC
    pulse_oidc_issuer        = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/pulse/"
    pulse_oidc_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.pulse.client_id
    pulse_oidc_client_secret = random_password.pulse_oidc_secret.result
    # Arcane OIDC
    arcane_oidc_issuer        = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/arcane/"
    arcane_oidc_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.arcane.client_id
    arcane_oidc_client_secret = random_password.arcane_oidc_secret.result
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/container-mgmt.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "container_mgmt_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.container_mgmt_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.container_mgmt.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "pulse_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pulse"
  backend_url = "http://${module.container_mgmt.ip_address}:7655"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pulse.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Forward auth via Authentik
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

module "arcane_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "arcane"
  backend_url = "http://${module.container_mgmt.ip_address}:3552"

  internal_domain = "arcane.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Forward auth via Authentik
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "container_mgmt_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.container_mgmt.container_id
  container_ip   = module.container_mgmt.ip_address
  container_name = "container-mgmt"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00" # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"         # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-104"

    pre_backup_commands = [] # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,container-mgmt"
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {

2. **Keep both** - forward auth + Arcane's login (double auth, not ideal)

# =============================================================================
# Container Management LXC - Pulse + Arcane
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 104
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Container monitoring (Pulse) and management (Arcane).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 104
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Container Management LXC
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "container_mgmt" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "container-mgmt"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - no LAN access needed)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 512

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Container Management"
  service_description = "Pulse monitoring + Arcane container management"

  service_urls = {
    pulse  = "https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}"
    arcane = "https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Pulse", port = 7655, info = "Proxmox + Docker monitoring" },
    { name = "Arcane", port = 3552, info = "Docker container management" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Pulse - Container Monitoring

Real-time monitoring for Proxmox VE and Docker containers.
- Dashboard: https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}
- Proxmox metrics via PVE API
- Docker metrics via socket

## Arcane - Container Management

Docker container management with update detection.
- Dashboard: https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}
- Remote agents connect from other LXCs

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f pulse
cd /config && docker compose logs -f arcane
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=container-mgmt` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["pulse", "arcane", "management"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "local_sensitive_file" "container_mgmt_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    pulse_admin_user      = local.op.pulse_admin_user
    pulse_admin_password  = local.op.pulse_admin_password
    arcane_encryption_key = local.op.arcane_encryption_key
    arcane_jwt_secret     = local.op.arcane_jwt_secret
    # Pulse OIDC
    pulse_oidc_issuer        = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/pulse/"
    pulse_oidc_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.pulse.client_id
    pulse_oidc_client_secret = random_password.pulse_oidc_secret.result
    # Arcane OIDC
    arcane_oidc_issuer        = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/arcane/"
    arcane_oidc_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.arcane.client_id
    arcane_oidc_client_secret = random_password.arcane_oidc_secret.result
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/container-mgmt.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "container_mgmt_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.container_mgmt_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.container_mgmt.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "pulse_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pulse"
  backend_url = "http://${module.container_mgmt.ip_address}:7655"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pulse.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Pulse uses native OIDC - no forward auth needed
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

module "arcane_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "arcane"
  backend_url = "http://${module.container_mgmt.ip_address}:3552"

  internal_domain = "arcane.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Forward auth via Authentik
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "container_mgmt_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.container_mgmt.container_id
  container_ip   = module.container_mgmt.ip_address
  container_name = "container-mgmt"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00" # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"         # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-104"

    pre_backup_commands = [] # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,container-mgmt"
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {

- Decommission Authelia

# =============================================================================
# Authelia LXC - Centralized Authentication (DEPRECATED)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 202
#
# DEPRECATED: Migrating to Authentik (LXC 203). This container will be
# decommissioned once all services are migrated to Authentik.
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authelia LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 202
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authelia Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authelia"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authelia"
  service_description = "Centralized authentication with TOTP 2FA and OIDC"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://authelia.${var.domain_internal}"  # Changed during Authentik migration
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authelia", port = 9091, info = "Authentication portal" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Session storage" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Configuration

**Config:** `/config/authelia/configuration.yml`
**Users:** `/config/authelia/users_database.yml`
**Secrets:** `/config/secrets/` (synced from deploy/secrets)

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f authelia
```

**Check auth status:**
```
curl -I http://localhost:9091/api/health
```

**Restart Authelia:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart authelia
```

## ForwardAuth Middleware

Add `"authelia"` to any service's middleware list to protect it:
```hcl
middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authelia` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authelia", "auth", "security"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authelia"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Changed from "auth." to "authelia." to avoid conflict with Authentik during migration
  internal_domain = "authelia.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.authelia]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authelia.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authelia.ip_address
  container_name = "authelia"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-202"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # Redis - no dump needed, config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authelia"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authelia"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authelia"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authelia]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authelia.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authelia.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authelia.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.authelia_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authelia_route.remote_config_path
}

# Common Traefik middlewares and transports for homelab
http:
  # ServersTransport for backends with self-signed certificates
  serversTransports:
    insecure:
      insecureSkipVerify: true

  middlewares:
    security-headers:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        forceSTSHeader: true
        stsIncludeSubdomains: true
        stsPreload: true
        stsSeconds: 31536000
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    public-security:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    # Internal-only: Allow only local network, container network, and Tailscale
    internal-only:
      ipAllowList:
        sourceRange:
          - "192.168.1.0/24"    # Local LAN
          - "10.100.0.0/16"     # Container network (LXC containers)
          - "172.16.0.0/12"     # Docker bridge networks (172.16-31.x.x)
          - "100.64.0.0/10"     # Tailscale CGNAT range
          - "127.0.0.1/32"      # Localhost

    # Cloudflare headers - ensures X-Forwarded-Proto: https for public routes
    # This fixes mixed content issues when Cloudflare terminates TLS
    cloudflare-https:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          X-Forwarded-Proto: "https"
          X-Forwarded-Ssl: "on"

    # Authelia forward auth middleware
    authelia:
      forwardAuth:
        address: "http://10.100.2.202:9091/api/authz/forward-auth"
        trustForwardHeader: true
        authResponseHeaders:
          - "Remote-User"
          - "Remote-Groups"
          - "Remote-Email"
          - "Remote-Name"

    # Ollama API basic auth
    ollama-auth:
      basicAuth:
        users:
          - "ollama-api:$2y$05$DmLSIME.Uvr6TZEr.qSRK.Nwt9bzfSOV5RXPly9tD8hlQwSGhQz0i"
        realm: "Ollama API"

# Common Traefik middlewares and transports for homelab
http:
  # ServersTransport for backends with self-signed certificates
  serversTransports:
    insecure:
      insecureSkipVerify: true

  middlewares:
    security-headers:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        forceSTSHeader: true
        stsIncludeSubdomains: true
        stsPreload: true
        stsSeconds: 31536000
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    public-security:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    # Internal-only: Allow only local network, container network, and Tailscale
    internal-only:
      ipAllowList:
        sourceRange:
          - "192.168.1.0/24"    # Local LAN
          - "10.100.0.0/16"     # Container network (LXC containers)
          - "172.16.0.0/12"     # Docker bridge networks (172.16-31.x.x)
          - "100.64.0.0/10"     # Tailscale CGNAT range
          - "127.0.0.1/32"      # Localhost

    # Cloudflare headers - ensures X-Forwarded-Proto: https for public routes
    # This fixes mixed content issues when Cloudflare terminates TLS
    cloudflare-https:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          X-Forwarded-Proto: "https"
          X-Forwarded-Ssl: "on"

    # Authelia forward auth middleware
    authelia:
      forwardAuth:
        address: "http://10.100.2.202:9091/api/authz/forward-auth"
        trustForwardHeader: true
        authResponseHeaders:
          - "Remote-User"
          - "Remote-Groups"
          - "Remote-Email"
          - "Remote-Name"

    # Ollama API basic auth
    ollama-auth:
      basicAuth:
        users:
          - "ollama-api:$2y$05$DmLSIME.Uvr6TZEr.qSRK.Nwt9bzfSOV5RXPly9tD8hlQwSGhQz0i"
        realm: "Ollama API"

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
      # 103 reserved for monitoring migration from 500
      container_mgmt   = "10.100.1.104"  # LXC 104 - Pulse + Arcane
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth (deprecated - migrating to authentik)
      authentik  = "10.100.2.203"  # LXC 203 - Identity Provider (replaces Authelia)
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    authelia         = "192.168.1.225"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
    monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Monitoring stack
    openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
    n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
    104 = local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia
    203 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,

}

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
      # 103 reserved for monitoring migration from 500
      container_mgmt   = "10.100.1.104"  # LXC 104 - Pulse + Arcane

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
      # 103 reserved for monitoring migration from 500
      container_mgmt   = "10.100.1.104"  # LXC 104 - Pulse + Arcane
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      # LXC 202 - Decommissioned (was Authelia, replaced by Authentik)
      authentik  = "10.100.2.203"  # LXC 203 - Identity Provider
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    # authelia - 192.168.1.225 decommissioned (LXC 202 destroyed)
    dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
    monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Monitoring stack
    openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
    n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
    104 = local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    # 202 - Decommissioned (was Authelia)
    203 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # - home mode: Use LAN IP (192.168.1.x) for direct access
  # - travel mode: Use container IP (10.100.x.x) routable via Tailscale
  traefik_ip = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik : local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips

#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access

    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)

    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

# =============================================================================
# Shared Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file is symlinked into each app directory to provide common variables
# and provider configuration. Each app has its own state file.
#
# Secret Management:
# - State encryption passphrase: Must remain as TF_VAR (needed before providers init)
# - All other secrets: Fetched from 1Password via onepassword provider
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# State Encryption (Required as TF_VAR - runs before providers)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "state_encryption_passphrase" {
  description = "Passphrase for encrypting state files (from 1Password: op://homelab/opentofu/password)"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "proxmox_node" {
  description = "Proxmox node name"
  type        = string
  default     = "pve"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SSH Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "ssh_private_key_path" {
  description = "Path to SSH private key"
  type        = string
  default     = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"
}

variable "ssh_public_key_path" {
  description = "Path to SSH public key"
  type        = string
  default     = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519.pub"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Storage & Network Defaults
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "default_storage" {
  description = "Default storage for LXC containers"
  type        = string
  default     = "tank"
}

variable "default_bridge" {
  description = "Default network bridge"
  type        = string
  default     = "vmbr0"
}

variable "lxc_template" {
  description = "Default LXC template (base Debian)"
  type        = string
  default     = "local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst"
}

variable "lxc_template_docker" {
  description = "LXC template with Docker pre-installed"
  type        = string
  default     = "local:vztmpl/debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Domain Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "domain_internal" {
  description = "Internal domain suffix"
  type        = string
  default     = "homelab.rambtech.dev"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]+[a-z0-9]$", var.domain_internal))
    error_message = "Internal domain must be a valid domain name (e.g., homelab.example.com)."
  }
}

variable "domain_public" {
  description = "Public domain"
  type        = string
  default     = "rambtech.dev"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]+[a-z0-9]$", var.domain_public))
    error_message = "Public domain must be a valid domain name (e.g., example.com)."
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Configuration (IDs only - tokens from 1Password)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "cloudflare_account_id" {
  description = "Cloudflare account ID"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "dns_mode" {

  type        = string
  default     = "home"

    error_message = "dns_mode must be either 'home' or 'travel'"
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Computed Locals
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

locals {
  ssh_public_key = file(var.ssh_public_key_path)

  # Proxmox connection settings based on dns_mode
  # - home: Use LAN IP (192.168.1.215) for direct access
  # - travel: Use container gateway IP (10.100.0.1) routable via Tailscale
  proxmox_lan_ip       = "192.168.1.215"
  proxmox_container_ip = "10.100.0.1"

  proxmox_host     = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.proxmox_container_ip : local.proxmox_lan_ip
  proxmox_endpoint = "https://${local.proxmox_host}:8006"
  proxmox_ssh_host = local.proxmox_host
}

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
      # 103 reserved for monitoring migration from 500
      container_mgmt   = "10.100.1.104"  # LXC 104 - Pulse + Arcane
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - DECOMMISSIONED (being destroyed)
      authentik  = "10.100.2.203"  # LXC 203 - Identity Provider
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    authelia         = "192.168.1.225"  # LXC 202 - DECOMMISSIONED (being destroyed)
    dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
    monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Monitoring stack
    openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
    n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
    104 = local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia  # DECOMMISSIONED
    203 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # - home mode: Use LAN IP (192.168.1.x) for direct access
  # - travel mode: Use container IP (10.100.x.x) routable via Tailscale
  traefik_ip = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik : local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}

# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab on Proxmox. All commands run from local machine.

## Beads - AI Issue Tracking

This repo uses [Beads](https://github.com/steveyegge/beads) for AI-native issue tracking. Beads helps AI agents manage complex, multi-step tasks by tracking dependencies between work items.
BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE: run 'bd onboard' and follow the instructions

### Quick Commands

```bash
# Find ready work (no blockers)
bd ready

# List all issues
bd list
bd list --status=in_progress

# Create an issue
bd create --title="Add new LXC container for XYZ" --type=task --priority=2

# View issue details
bd show <id>

# Update status
bd update <id> --status=in_progress
bd update <id> --status=done

# Close completed work
bd close <id>
bd close <id1> <id2> ...  # Close multiple at once

# Add dependencies (issue depends on depends-on)
bd dep add <issue> <depends-on>

# Sync with git
bd sync
```

### For AI Agents

When starting work on this repo:

1. Run `bd ready` to see available tasks
2. Pick an issue and run `bd update <id> --status in_progress`
3. Complete the work
4. Run `bd close <id>` when done

Use `bd prime` to generate context for your session. Dependencies are tracked automatically - issues marked as "blocking" others will show up in the `bd ready` output once completed.

## Quick Reference

```bash
# OpenTofu workflow
task tofu:init APP=dashboards
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# PBS Backups (Proxmox Backup Server - incremental, in-container)
task pbs:backup APP=n8n          # Trigger manual PBS backup
task pbs:backup:all              # Backup all apps
task pbs:backup:list APP=n8n     # List PBS snapshots
task pbs:backup:status APP=n8n   # Show backup status
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n SNAPSHOT=latest  # Restore from PBS

# Legacy vzdump backups (full container snapshots)
task backup:status               # View backup status
task backup:now APP=immich       # Manual backup
task backup:list APP=immich      # List backups

# DNS mode (for remote access via Tailscale)
task dns:status                  # Show current mode
task dns:travel                  # Switch to travel mode (Tailscale IPs)
task dns:home                    # Switch to home mode (LAN IPs)

# Desktop LXC (temporary GUI for downloads)
task desktop:create
task desktop:info
task desktop:destroy

# Beads issue tracking
bd ready                         # Show ready work (no blockers)
bd list                          # List all issues
bd create --title="..."          # Create new issue
bd show <id>                     # View issue details
bd close <id>                    # Complete an issue
```

## Architecture

### Network Topology

```text
Internet
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Verizon FIOS Router (192.168.1.1)                               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

## DNS Mode (Travel vs Home)

When working remotely via Tailscale, switch to travel mode:

Travel mode changes:

│   ├── openwebui/         # AI chat (ID: 501)
│   └── traefik/           # Reverse proxy (ID: 200)
├── modules/               # Reusable modules
│   ├── cloudflare-tunnel/ # Cloudflare tunnel config
│   ├── common/            # Shared utilities
│   ├── docker-lxc/        # LXC + Docker + compose deployment

## Key Modules

- **docker-lxc**: Creates LXC + installs Docker + deploys compose stack
- **lxc-base**: Base LXC container with static IP, dual-NIC support
- **lxc-sidecars**: Configures PBS backup client, DIUN for container updates
- **traefik-route**: Generates and syncs Traefik dynamic route configs
- **cloudflare-tunnel**: Configures Cloudflare tunnel for public access

## PBS Backups (Proxmox Backup Server)

PBS provides incremental, deduplicated backups of docker volumes from within containers.

### How it works

1. `lxc-sidecars` module installs `proxmox-backup-client` in each container
2. Creates systemd timer for scheduled backups (default: daily)
3. Backs up docker volumes to PBS (LXC 102) with deduplication
4. Sends notifications to ntfy `backup-alerts` channel

### Configuration (in app's main.tf)

```hcl
module "sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "02:00"      # Daily at 2 AM
    retention = 7            # Keep 7 backups
    include_paths = ["/config"]
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Dump PostgreSQL"
        command = "docker exec postgres pg_dump -U user db > /config/db.sql"
        timeout = "5m"
      }
    ]
    notify_on_success = true
    notify_on_failure = true
  }
}
```

### Manual Operations

```bash
# Trigger backup
task pbs:backup APP=n8n

# List snapshots
task pbs:backup:list APP=n8n

# Restore (stops container, restores data, restarts)
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n SNAPSHOT=latest
```

## Network Domains

- `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` - Internal services (Traefik websecure)
- `*.rambtech.dev` - Public services (Cloudflare tunnel)

## Monitoring Stack

The monitoring LXC (ID: 500, IP: 10.100.5.100) runs:

| Component | Port | Purpose |
| --------- | ---- | ------- |
| Prometheus | 9090 | Metrics storage + alerting |
| Alertmanager | 9093 | Alert routing (ntfy + Discord) |
| Grafana | 3000 | Dashboards |
| Uptime Kuma | 3001 | HTTP monitoring |
| ntfy | 8080 | Push notifications |

### Key URLs

- Grafana: `https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Prometheus: `https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Alertmanager: `https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Uptime Kuma: `https://status.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- ntfy: `https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev`

### ntfy Channels

| Channel | Purpose |
| ------- | ------- |
| `homelab-alerts` | Prometheus/Alertmanager alerts |
| `backup-alerts` | PBS backup notifications |

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed via the 1Password OpenTofu provider.

### Key Files

- `tofu/onepassword.tf` - Data sources + `local.op` helper (symlinked to apps)
- `tofu/versions.tf` - Provider configs using `local.op.*`

### Available Secrets

```hcl
local.op.proxmox_api_token       # Proxmox API authentication
local.op.cloudflare_api_token    # Cloudflare DNS/tunnel API
local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token # Cloudflare tunnel token
local.op.grafana_admin_password  # Grafana admin password
local.op.discord_webhook_url     # Discord alertmanager webhook
```

### Adding New Secrets

1. Create item in 1Password `homelab` vault
2. Add data source to `tofu/onepassword.tf`
3. Add to `local.op` map in same file
4. Use in modules: `local.op.myservice_password`

### Why TF_VAR for State Encryption

State encryption runs before providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider:

```yaml
# Taskfile.yml
env:
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"
```

## Important Notes

- SSH to Proxmox: `ssh root@homelab`
- Use container IPs (10.100.x.x) in provisioners when in travel mode
- State files are encrypted and committed to git
- Each app has independent state in `tofu/apps/<app>/`
- 1Password CLI v2.23.0+ required (uses biometric auth)

## Taskfile Usage

**ALWAYS prefer running tasks from the Taskfile over direct commands.**

This repository uses a Taskfile for all common operations. Before running any command directly, check if there's a task for it using `task --list`.

Examples:

- Use `task tofu:apply APP=immich` instead of `cd tofu && tofu apply`
- Use `task pbs:backup APP=n8n` instead of SSH commands to trigger backups
- Use `task dns:travel` instead of manually editing TF_VAR_dns_mode

## OpenTofu/Terraform Workflow

**CRITICAL: OpenTofu commands must ALWAYS follow this sequence with NO skips:**

1. `task tofu:init APP=<app>` - Initialize the workspace
2. `task tofu:plan APP=<app>` - Generate and review the execution plan
3. `task tofu:apply APP=<app>` - Apply the changes

Never skip steps. Always run init, then plan, then apply - even if you think init has already been run.

## File Transfer Restrictions

**CRITICAL: You are strictly forbidden to transfer files over to any remote server under any circumstance unless the user has explicitly given you permission.**

This includes but is not limited to:

- SSH file transfers (scp, rsync, sftp)
- Copying files to LXC containers
- Uploading files to cloud services
- Any form of remote file deployment

You must always ask for explicit permission before transferring any files to remote systems.

     5→# Sets up scheduled backup jobs in Proxmox VE to use PBS storage.
     6→# Replaces manual editing of /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
     7→#
     8→# Usage:

    10→#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
    11→# =============================================================================
    12→
    13→- name: Configure PBS backup jobs
    14→  hosts: proxmox
    15→  gather_facts: false
    16→
    17→  vars:
    18→    pbs_storage: pbs-homelab
    19→    pbs_datastore: homelab

    21→    # Daily backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
    22→    daily_containers:
    23→      - 304  # immich
    24→      - 303  # immich-importer
    25→      - 501  # openwebui
    26→      - 502  # n8n
    27→      - 503  # obsidian-sync
    28→      - 504  # documents

    31→    weekly_containers:
    32→      - 101  # network-services

    34→      - 201  # dashboards-app

    43→    # =========================================================================
    44→    - name: Check PBS storage status
    45→      ansible.builtin.shell:
    46→        cmd: pvesm status | grep {{ pbs_storage }}
    47→      register: pbs_status
    48→      changed_when: false
    49→      tags: [always]
    50→
    51→    - name: Verify PBS is active
    52→      ansible.builtin.fail:
    53→        msg: |
    54→          PBS storage '{{ pbs_storage }}' is not active.
    55→          Status: {{ pbs_status.stdout }}
    56→          Fix by updating PBS password:
    57→            pvesm set {{ pbs_storage }} --password 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
    58→      when: "'active' not in pbs_status.stdout"
    59→      tags: [always]
    60→
    61→    # =========================================================================
    62→    # Backup Pre-Backup Hook Script
    63→    # =========================================================================
    64→    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
    65→      ansible.builtin.stat:
    66→        path: /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
    67→      register: hook_script
    68→      tags: [always]
    69→
    70→    - name: Display hook script status
    71→      ansible.builtin.debug:
    72→        msg: "Pre-backup hook: {{ 'EXISTS' if hook_script.stat.exists else 'MISSING' }}"
    73→      tags: [verify]
    74→
    75→    # =========================================================================
    76→    # Configure Backup Jobs

    84→          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - Changes will be overwritten
    85→          #
    86→          # Backup Strategy:

    88→          #   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, etc.)
    89→          #

    91→          # Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}

    98→          # 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
    99→          # 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
   100→          # 503 = obsidian-sync (notes sync server)

   102→          vzdump: daily-user-data

   106→          	mailnotification failure

   110→          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Jobs for PBS
# =============================================================================
# Sets up scheduled backup jobs in Proxmox VE to use PBS storage.
# Replaces manual editing of /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
#
# Usage:
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup jobs
  hosts: proxmox
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_storage: pbs-homelab
    pbs_datastore: homelab

    # Daily backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
    daily_containers:
      - 304  # immich
      - 303  # immich-importer
      - 501  # openwebui
      - 502  # n8n
      - 503  # obsidian-sync
      - 504  # documents

    # Weekly backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
    weekly_containers:
      - 101  # network-services
      - 200  # traefik
      - 201  # dashboards-app
      - 202  # authelia
      - 401  # jellyfin
      - 402  # media-management
      - 500  # monitoring-app

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS Storage
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS storage status
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesm status | grep {{ pbs_storage }}
      register: pbs_status
      changed_when: false
      tags: [always]

    - name: Verify PBS is active
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS storage '{{ pbs_storage }}' is not active.
          Status: {{ pbs_status.stdout }}
          Fix by updating PBS password:
            pvesm set {{ pbs_storage }} --password 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
      when: "'active' not in pbs_status.stdout"
      tags: [always]

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup Pre-Backup Hook Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
      register: hook_script
      tags: [always]

    - name: Display hook script status
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Pre-backup hook: {{ 'EXISTS' if hook_script.stat.exists else 'MISSING' }}"
      tags: [verify]

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure Backup Jobs
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup jobs configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        content: |
          # Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
          # Managed by Ansible: ansible/playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - Changes will be overwritten
          #
          # Backup Strategy:
          #   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (immich, openwebui, n8n, etc.)
          #   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, etc.)
          #
          # Storage: {{ pbs_storage }} (Proxmox Backup Server)
          # Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}

          # =============================================================================
          # Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
          # =============================================================================
          # 304 = immich (photos database)
          # 303 = immich-importer (import tools)
          # 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
          # 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
          # 503 = obsidian-sync (notes sync server)
          # 504 = documents (paperless, stirling-pdf)
          vzdump: daily-user-data
          	enabled 1
          	schedule 02:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ daily_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-daily=7

          # =============================================================================
          # Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
          # =============================================================================
          # 101 = network-services (adguard)
          # 200 = traefik
          # 201 = dashboards-app
          # 202 = authelia
          # 401 = jellyfin
          # 402 = media-management
          # 500 = monitoring-app
          vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
          	enabled 1
          	schedule sun 03:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ weekly_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-weekly=4
        mode: '0640'
      register: jobs_config
      tags: [configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: List configured backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesh get /cluster/backup --output-format=json-pretty
      register: backup_jobs
      changed_when: false
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_jobs.stdout | from_json }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Count daily backup containers
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        daily_count: "{{ daily_containers | length }}"
        weekly_count: "{{ weekly_containers | length }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Jobs Configured ==="
          - ""
          - "Storage: {{ pbs_storage }}"
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "Daily Backups ({{ daily_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Daily at 2:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 7 days"
          - "  Containers: {{ daily_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Weekly Backups ({{ weekly_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Sunday at 3:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 4 weeks"
          - "  Containers: {{ weekly_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Excluded from backups:"
          - "  102 = proxmox-backup-server (PBS itself)"
          - "  600 = desktop-tmp (temporary desktop)"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Backup"
          - "  2. Test backup: Run backup job manually"
          - "  3. Monitor PBS: https://10.100.1.102:8007"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Manual Trigger (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Trigger daily backup now (manual)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: pvesh create /cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up --output-format=json
      register: trigger_result
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

    - name: Display trigger result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ trigger_result.stdout | from_json }}"
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]
