---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Jobs for PBS
# =============================================================================
# Sets up scheduled backup jobs in Proxmox VE to use PBS storage.
# Replaces manual editing of /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
#
# Usage:
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup jobs
  hosts: proxmox
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_storage: pbs-homelab
    pbs_datastore: homelab

    # Daily backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
    daily_containers:
      - 304  # immich
      - 303  # immich-importer
      - 501  # openwebui
      - 502  # n8n
      - 503  # obsidian-sync
      - 504  # documents

    # Weekly backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
    weekly_containers:
      - 101  # network-services
      - 200  # traefik
      - 201  # dashboards-app
      - 202  # authelia
      - 401  # jellyfin
      - 402  # media-management
      - 500  # monitoring-app

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS Storage
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS storage status
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesm status | grep {{ pbs_storage }}
      register: pbs_status
      changed_when: false
      tags: [always]

    - name: Verify PBS is active
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS storage '{{ pbs_storage }}' is not active.
          Status: {{ pbs_status.stdout }}
          Fix by updating PBS password:
            pvesm set {{ pbs_storage }} --password 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
      when: "'active' not in pbs_status.stdout"
      tags: [always]

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup Pre-Backup Hook Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
      register: hook_script
      tags: [always]

    - name: Display hook script status
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Pre-backup hook: {{ 'EXISTS' if hook_script.stat.exists else 'MISSING' }}"
      tags: [verify]

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure Backup Jobs
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup jobs configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        content: |
          # Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
          # Managed by Ansible: ansible/playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - Changes will be overwritten
          #
          # Backup Strategy:
          #   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (immich, openwebui, n8n, etc.)
          #   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, etc.)
          #
          # Storage: {{ pbs_storage }} (Proxmox Backup Server)
          # Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}

          # =============================================================================
          # Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
          # =============================================================================
          # 304 = immich (photos database)
          # 303 = immich-importer (import tools)
          # 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
          # 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
          # 503 = obsidian-sync (notes sync server)
          # 504 = documents (paperless, stirling-pdf)
          vzdump: daily-user-data
          	enabled 1
          	schedule 02:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ daily_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-daily=7

          # =============================================================================
          # Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
          # =============================================================================
          # 101 = network-services (adguard)
          # 200 = traefik
          # 201 = dashboards-app
          # 202 = authelia
          # 401 = jellyfin
          # 402 = media-management
          # 500 = monitoring-app
          vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
          	enabled 1
          	schedule sun 03:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ weekly_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-weekly=4
        mode: '0640'
      register: jobs_config
      tags: [configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: List configured backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesh get /cluster/backup --output-format=json-pretty
      register: backup_jobs
      changed_when: false
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_jobs.stdout | from_json }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Count daily backup containers
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        daily_count: "{{ daily_containers | length }}"
        weekly_count: "{{ weekly_containers | length }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Jobs Configured ==="
          - ""
          - "Storage: {{ pbs_storage }}"
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "Daily Backups ({{ daily_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Daily at 2:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 7 days"
          - "  Containers: {{ daily_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Weekly Backups ({{ weekly_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Sunday at 3:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 4 weeks"
          - "  Containers: {{ weekly_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Excluded from backups:"
          - "  102 = proxmox-backup-server (PBS itself)"
          - "  600 = desktop-tmp (temporary desktop)"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Backup"
          - "  2. Test backup: Run backup job manually"
          - "  3. Monitor PBS: https://10.100.1.102:8007"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Manual Trigger (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Trigger daily backup now (manual)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: pvesh create /cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up --output-format=json
      register: trigger_result
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

    - name: Display trigger result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ trigger_result.stdout | from_json }}"
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets + OIDC config
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${jsonencode({
    openid_connect = {
      APPS = [{
        provider_id = "authentik"
        name        = "Authentik"
        client_id   = authentik_provider_oauth2.paperless.client_id
        secret      = random_password.paperless_oidc_secret.result
        settings = {
          server_url = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/paperless/"
        }
      }]
      OAUTH_PKCE_ENABLED = "True"
    }
  })}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed

  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-504"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "pdf.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_public   = module.stirling_pdf_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
# Synced via: task backup:sync
# Docs: https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Backup_and_Restore
#
# Backup Tiers:
#   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (openwebui, immich, n8n)
#   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, etc.)
#
# To add a new container:
#   1. Add the container ID to the appropriate job below
#   2. Run: task backup:sync
#   3. (Optional) Add pre-backup hook in pre-backup-hook.sh if database dump needed

# =============================================================================
# Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
# =============================================================================
# 304 = immich (photos database)
# 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
# 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
vzdump: daily-user-data
	enabled 1
	schedule 02:00
	storage backup-tank
	mailnotification failure
	mode snapshot
	compress zstd
	vmid 304,501,502
	script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
	prune-backups keep-daily=7

# =============================================================================
# Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
# =============================================================================
# 101 = network-services (adguard)
# 200 = traefik
# 201 = dashboards
# 202 = authelia
# 401 = jellyfin
# 402 = media-management
# 500 = monitoring
vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
	enabled 1
	schedule sun 03:00
	storage backup-tank
	mailnotification failure
	mode snapshot
	compress zstd
	vmid 101,200,201,202,401,402,500
	script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
	prune-backups keep-weekly=4

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# OpenTofu Batch Operations
# =============================================================================
# Runs tofu plan/apply across all apps with logging.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/tofu-all.sh plan    # Plan all apps
#   ./scripts/tofu-all.sh apply   # Apply all apps (runs plan first)
#   ./scripts/tofu-all.sh status  # Show last run status
# =============================================================================

set -eo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
TOFU_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps"
LOG_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/logs/tofu"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

# All apps in dependency order (infrastructure first, then services)
APPS=(
    network-services
    traefik
    authelia
    dashboards
    container-mgmt
    monitoring
    immich
    jellyfin
    media-management
    openwebui
    n8n
    obsidian-sync
    documents
)

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[0;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

log() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[$(date +%H:%M:%S)]${NC} $1"
}

success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $1"
}

error() {
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $1"
}

warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}!${NC} $1"
}

# Ensure log directory exists
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

# Run tofu plan for all apps
run_plan() {
    local plan_log="$LOG_DIR/plan-$TIMESTAMP.log"
    local failed_apps=()
    local changed_apps=()

    log "Starting tofu plan for all apps..."
    log "Log file: $plan_log"
    echo ""

    echo "=== Tofu Plan - $TIMESTAMP ===" > "$plan_log"
    echo "" >> "$plan_log"

    for app in "${APPS[@]}"; do
        local app_dir="$TOFU_DIR/$app"

        if [[ ! -d "$app_dir" ]]; then
            warn "$app - directory not found, skipping"
            echo "[$app] SKIPPED - directory not found" >> "$plan_log"
            continue
        fi

        printf "  %-20s " "$app"

        echo "" >> "$plan_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"
        echo "[$app] $(date)" >> "$plan_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"

        if (cd "$app_dir" && tofu plan -detailed-exitcode -out=tfplan.out 2>&1) >> "$plan_log" 2>&1; then
            # Exit code 0 = no changes
            success "No changes"
            echo "[$app] STATUS: No changes" >> "$plan_log"
        else
            local exit_code=$?
            if [[ $exit_code -eq 2 ]]; then
                # Exit code 2 = changes present
                warn "Changes detected"
                echo "[$app] STATUS: Changes detected" >> "$plan_log"
                changed_apps+=("$app")
            else
                # Other exit codes = error
                error "Failed (see log)"
                echo "[$app] STATUS: FAILED" >> "$plan_log"
                failed_apps+=("$app")
            fi
        fi
    done

    echo "" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "SUMMARY" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "Changed: ${changed_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "Failed: ${failed_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$plan_log"

    echo ""
    log "Plan complete."

    if [[ ${#changed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        warn "Apps with changes: ${changed_apps[*]}"
    fi

    if [[ ${#failed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        error "Failed apps: ${failed_apps[*]}"
        echo ""
        log "Check log for details: $plan_log"
        return 1
    fi

    # Save changed apps list for apply phase
    if [[ ${#changed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "${changed_apps[@]}" > "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt"
    else
        rm -f "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt"
    fi

    return 0
}

# Run tofu apply for all apps
run_apply() {
    local apply_log="$LOG_DIR/apply-$TIMESTAMP.log"
    local failed_apps=()
    local applied_apps=()

    log "Starting tofu apply for all apps..."
    log "Log file: $apply_log"
    echo ""

    echo "=== Tofu Apply - $TIMESTAMP ===" > "$apply_log"
    echo "" >> "$apply_log"

    for app in "${APPS[@]}"; do
        local app_dir="$TOFU_DIR/$app"

        if [[ ! -d "$app_dir" ]]; then
            warn "$app - directory not found, skipping"
            echo "[$app] SKIPPED - directory not found" >> "$apply_log"
            continue
        fi

        printf "  %-20s " "$app"

        echo "" >> "$apply_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"
        echo "[$app] $(date)" >> "$apply_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"

        # Check if plan file exists, if not run plan first
        local plan_file="$app_dir/tfplan.out"
        if [[ ! -f "$plan_file" ]]; then
            echo "[$app] No plan file, running plan first..." >> "$apply_log"
            if ! (cd "$app_dir" && tofu plan -out=tfplan.out 2>&1) >> "$apply_log" 2>&1; then
                error "Plan failed"
                echo "[$app] STATUS: PLAN FAILED" >> "$apply_log"
                failed_apps+=("$app")
                continue
            fi
        fi

        if (cd "$app_dir" && tofu apply -auto-approve tfplan.out 2>&1) >> "$apply_log" 2>&1; then
            success "Applied"
            echo "[$app] STATUS: Applied successfully" >> "$apply_log"
            applied_apps+=("$app")
            # Clean up plan file
            rm -f "$plan_file"
        else
            error "Failed (see log)"
            echo "[$app] STATUS: APPLY FAILED" >> "$apply_log"
            failed_apps+=("$app")
            rm -f "$plan_file"
        fi
    done

    echo "" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "SUMMARY" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "Applied: ${applied_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "Failed: ${failed_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$apply_log"

    echo ""
    log "Apply complete."

    if [[ ${#applied_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        success "Applied apps: ${applied_apps[*]}"
    fi

    if [[ ${#failed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        error "Failed apps: ${failed_apps[*]}"
        echo ""
        log "Check log for details: $apply_log"
        return 1
    fi

    # Clear pending changes
    rm -f "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt"

    return 0
}

# Show status of last run
show_status() {
    echo ""
    log "Recent tofu logs:"
    echo ""

    if [[ -d "$LOG_DIR" ]]; then
        ls -lt "$LOG_DIR"/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo "  No logs found"
    else
        echo "  Log directory not found"
    fi

    echo ""

    if [[ -f "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt" ]]; then
        warn "Pending changes (not yet applied):"
        cat "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt" | sed 's/^/  /'
    fi
}

# Clean up plan files
clean_plans() {
    log "Cleaning up plan files..."
    for app in "${APPS[@]}"; do
        rm -f "$TOFU_DIR/$app/tfplan.out"
    done
    success "Plan files cleaned"
}

# Main
case "${1:-}" in
    plan)
        run_plan
        ;;
    apply)
        run_apply
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    clean)
        clean_plans
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 {plan|apply|status|clean}"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  plan   - Run tofu plan for all apps"
        echo "  apply  - Run tofu apply for all apps"
        echo "  status - Show recent logs and pending changes"
        echo "  clean  - Remove generated plan files"
        echo ""
        echo "Logs are saved to: $LOG_DIR"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generic app config sync script
# Usage: ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh <app> [pull|push]
#
# Syncs config between repo and container using rsync.
# Automatically gets container IP from tofu output.

set -euo pipefail

APP="${1:-}"
ACTION="${2:-push}"

if [[ -z "$APP" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <app> [pull|push]"
    echo "Apps: authelia, dashboards, immich, openwebui"
    exit 1
fi

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
TOFU_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps/$APP"
DEPLOY_DIR="$TOFU_DIR/deploy"

# Get container IP from tofu output
get_ip() {
    cd "$TOFU_DIR"
    IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    if [[ -z "$IP" || "$IP" == "null" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Could not get IP for $APP. Is it deployed?" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "$IP"
}

IP=$(get_ip)

case "$ACTION" in
    push|sync)
        echo "Syncing $APP config to container ($IP)..."
        rsync -avz --delete "$DEPLOY_DIR/" "root@$IP:/config/"

        # Handle secrets permissions if they exist
        if ssh "root@$IP" "test -d /config/secrets" 2>/dev/null; then
            ssh "root@$IP" "chmod 600 /config/secrets/*"
        fi

        # Restart containers
        ssh "root@$IP" "cd /config && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d"
        echo "✅ $APP synced and restarted"
        ;;
    pull)
        echo "Pulling $APP config from container ($IP)..."
        # Only pull config files, not secrets or data
        rsync -avz --exclude='secrets/' --exclude='*.db' --exclude='*.sqlite*' \
            "root@$IP:/config/" "$DEPLOY_DIR/"
        echo "✅ $APP config pulled to repo"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unknown action: $ACTION"
        echo "Use 'push' or 'pull'"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Freshness Monitor
# =============================================================================
# Checks that backups are not stale and sends alerts via ntfy if issues found.
# Run via cron on Proxmox: 0 6 * * * /var/lib/vz/snippets/backup-monitor.sh
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 - All backups OK
#   1 - Alert sent (stale or missing backups)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/tank/backups/vzdump/dump"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"
NTFY_URL="${NTFY_URL:-http://10.100.5.100:8093/homelab-alerts}"
LOGFILE="/var/log/backup-monitor.log"

# Thresholds in hours
DAILY_THRESHOLD=36    # Alert if daily backups > 36 hours old
WEEKLY_THRESHOLD=192  # Alert if weekly backups > 8 days old

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

send_alert() {
    local priority="$1"
    local title="$2"
    local message="$3"
    local tags="$4"

    log "ALERT [$priority]: $title - $message"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_URL" || log "Failed to send ntfy alert"
}

# Check age of most recent backup file matching pattern
check_backup_age() {
    local pattern="$1"
    local name="$2"
    local threshold_hours="$3"
    local dir="${4:-$BACKUP_DIR}"

    local newest
    newest=$(find "$dir" -name "$pattern" -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)

    if [[ -z "$newest" ]]; then
        send_alert "urgent" "Backup Missing: $name" "No backups found matching $pattern" "warning,backup"
        return 1
    fi

    local age_seconds
    age_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$newest") ))
    local age_hours=$(( age_seconds / 3600 ))

    if [[ $age_hours -gt $threshold_hours ]]; then
        local age_days=$(( age_hours / 24 ))
        send_alert "high" "Stale Backup: $name" "Last backup is ${age_days}d ${age_hours}h old (threshold: ${threshold_hours}h). File: $(basename "$newest")" "warning,backup,clock"
        return 1
    fi

    log "OK: $name - newest backup is ${age_hours}h old ($(basename "$newest"))"
    return 0
}

# =============================================================================
# Main
# =============================================================================

log "Starting backup freshness check"
ALERT_COUNT=0

# Daily backups (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-304-*.tar.zst" "Immich (304)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-501-*.tar.zst" "OpenWebUI (501)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-502-*.tar.zst" "n8n (502)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Database dumps (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "immich-postgres-*.sql.gz" "Immich DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "openwebui-*.db" "OpenWebUI DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "n8n-*.db" "n8n DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Weekly backups (should be < 8 days old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst" "Network Services (101)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst" "Traefik (200)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-201-*.tar.zst" "Dashboards (201)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-202-*.tar.zst" "Authelia (202)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

log "Backup check completed: $ALERT_COUNT issues found"

if [[ $ALERT_COUNT -gt 0 ]]; then
    exit 1
fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# OpenTofu Batch Operations
# =============================================================================
# Runs tofu plan/apply across all apps with logging.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/tofu-all.sh plan    # Plan all apps
#   ./scripts/tofu-all.sh apply   # Apply all apps (runs plan first)
#   ./scripts/tofu-all.sh status  # Show last run status
# =============================================================================

set -eo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
TOFU_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps"
LOG_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/logs/tofu"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

# All apps in dependency order (infrastructure first, then services)
APPS=(
    network-services
    traefik
    authelia
    dashboards
    container-mgmt
    monitoring
    immich
    jellyfin
    media-management
    openwebui
    n8n
    obsidian-sync
    documents
)

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[0;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

log() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[$(date +%H:%M:%S)]${NC} $1"
}

success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $1"
}

error() {
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $1"
}

warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}!${NC} $1"
}

# Ensure log directory exists
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

# Run tofu plan for all apps
run_plan() {
    local plan_log="$LOG_DIR/plan-$TIMESTAMP.log"
    local failed_apps=()
    local changed_apps=()

    log "Starting tofu plan for all apps..."
    log "Log file: $plan_log"
    echo ""

    echo "=== Tofu Plan - $TIMESTAMP ===" > "$plan_log"
    echo "" >> "$plan_log"

    for app in "${APPS[@]}"; do
        local app_dir="$TOFU_DIR/$app"

        if [[ ! -d "$app_dir" ]]; then
            warn "$app - directory not found, skipping"
            echo "[$app] SKIPPED - directory not found" >> "$plan_log"
            continue
        fi

        printf "  %-20s " "$app"

        echo "" >> "$plan_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"
        echo "[$app] $(date)" >> "$plan_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"

        if (cd "$app_dir" && tofu plan -detailed-exitcode -out=tfplan.out 2>&1) >> "$plan_log" 2>&1; then
            # Exit code 0 = no changes
            success "No changes"
            echo "[$app] STATUS: No changes" >> "$plan_log"
        else
            local exit_code=$?
            if [[ $exit_code -eq 2 ]]; then
                # Exit code 2 = changes present
                warn "Changes detected"
                echo "[$app] STATUS: Changes detected" >> "$plan_log"
                changed_apps+=("$app")
            else
                # Other exit codes = error
                error "Failed (see log)"
                echo "[$app] STATUS: FAILED" >> "$plan_log"
                failed_apps+=("$app")
            fi
        fi
    done

    echo "" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "SUMMARY" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "Changed: ${changed_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$plan_log"
    echo "Failed: ${failed_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$plan_log"

    echo ""
    log "Plan complete."

    if [[ ${#changed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        warn "Apps with changes: ${changed_apps[*]}"
    fi

    if [[ ${#failed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        error "Failed apps: ${failed_apps[*]}"
        echo ""
        log "Check log for details: $plan_log"
        return 1
    fi

    # Save changed apps list for apply phase
    if [[ ${#changed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "${changed_apps[@]}" > "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt"
    else
        rm -f "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt"
    fi

    return 0
}

# Run tofu apply for all apps
run_apply() {
    local apply_log="$LOG_DIR/apply-$TIMESTAMP.log"
    local failed_apps=()
    local applied_apps=()

    log "Starting tofu apply for all apps..."
    log "Log file: $apply_log"
    echo ""

    echo "=== Tofu Apply - $TIMESTAMP ===" > "$apply_log"
    echo "" >> "$apply_log"

    for app in "${APPS[@]}"; do
        local app_dir="$TOFU_DIR/$app"

        if [[ ! -d "$app_dir" ]]; then
            warn "$app - directory not found, skipping"
            echo "[$app] SKIPPED - directory not found" >> "$apply_log"
            continue
        fi

        printf "  %-20s " "$app"

        echo "" >> "$apply_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"
        echo "[$app] $(date)" >> "$apply_log"
        echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"

        # Check if plan file exists, if not run plan first
        local plan_file="$app_dir/tfplan.out"
        if [[ ! -f "$plan_file" ]]; then
            echo "[$app] No plan file, running plan first..." >> "$apply_log"
            if ! (cd "$app_dir" && tofu plan -out=tfplan.out 2>&1) >> "$apply_log" 2>&1; then
                error "Plan failed"
                echo "[$app] STATUS: PLAN FAILED" >> "$apply_log"
                failed_apps+=("$app")
                continue
            fi
        fi

        if (cd "$app_dir" && tofu apply -auto-approve tfplan.out 2>&1) >> "$apply_log" 2>&1; then
            success "Applied"
            echo "[$app] STATUS: Applied successfully" >> "$apply_log"
            applied_apps+=("$app")
            # Clean up plan file
            rm -f "$plan_file"
        else
            error "Failed (see log)"
            echo "[$app] STATUS: APPLY FAILED" >> "$apply_log"
            failed_apps+=("$app")
            rm -f "$plan_file"
        fi
    done

    echo "" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "SUMMARY" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "========================================" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "Applied: ${applied_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$apply_log"
    echo "Failed: ${failed_apps[*]:-none}" >> "$apply_log"

    echo ""
    log "Apply complete."

    if [[ ${#applied_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        success "Applied apps: ${applied_apps[*]}"
    fi

    if [[ ${#failed_apps[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        error "Failed apps: ${failed_apps[*]}"
        echo ""
        log "Check log for details: $apply_log"
        return 1
    fi

    # Clear pending changes
    rm -f "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt"

    return 0
}

# Show status of last run
show_status() {
    echo ""
    log "Recent tofu logs:"
    echo ""

    if [[ -d "$LOG_DIR" ]]; then
        ls -lt "$LOG_DIR"/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo "  No logs found"
    else
        echo "  Log directory not found"
    fi

    echo ""

    if [[ -f "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt" ]]; then
        warn "Pending changes (not yet applied):"
        cat "$LOG_DIR/pending-changes.txt" | sed 's/^/  /'
    fi
}

# Clean up plan files
clean_plans() {
    log "Cleaning up plan files..."
    for app in "${APPS[@]}"; do
        rm -f "$TOFU_DIR/$app/tfplan.out"
    done
    success "Plan files cleaned"
}

# Main
case "${1:-}" in
    plan)
        run_plan
        ;;
    apply)
        run_apply
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    clean)
        clean_plans
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 {plan|apply|status|clean}"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  plan   - Run tofu plan for all apps"
        echo "  apply  - Run tofu apply for all apps"
        echo "  status - Show recent logs and pending changes"
        echo "  clean  - Remove generated plan files"
        echo ""
        echo "Logs are saved to: $LOG_DIR"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generic app config sync script
# Usage: ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh <app> [pull|push]
#
# Syncs config between repo and container using rsync.
# Automatically gets container IP from tofu output.

set -euo pipefail

APP="${1:-}"
ACTION="${2:-push}"

if [[ -z "$APP" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <app> [pull|push]"
    echo "Apps: authelia, dashboards, immich, openwebui"
    exit 1
fi

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
TOFU_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps/$APP"
DEPLOY_DIR="$TOFU_DIR/deploy"

# Get container IP from tofu output
get_ip() {
    cd "$TOFU_DIR"
    IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    if [[ -z "$IP" || "$IP" == "null" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Could not get IP for $APP. Is it deployed?" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "$IP"
}

IP=$(get_ip)

case "$ACTION" in
    push|sync)
        echo "Syncing $APP config to container ($IP)..."
        rsync -avz --delete "$DEPLOY_DIR/" "root@$IP:/config/"

        # Handle secrets permissions if they exist
        if ssh "root@$IP" "test -d /config/secrets" 2>/dev/null; then
            ssh "root@$IP" "chmod 600 /config/secrets/*"
        fi

        # Restart containers
        ssh "root@$IP" "cd /config && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d"
        echo "✅ $APP synced and restarted"
        ;;
    pull)
        echo "Pulling $APP config from container ($IP)..."
        # Only pull config files, not secrets or data
        rsync -avz --exclude='secrets/' --exclude='*.db' --exclude='*.sqlite*' \
            "root@$IP:/config/" "$DEPLOY_DIR/"
        echo "✅ $APP config pulled to repo"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unknown action: $ACTION"
        echo "Use 'push' or 'pull'"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
